The Experience

Join our world-class Employee Success Business Partner (ESBP) team during a pivotal era where CRM, AI, Data, and Trust converge. As a Strategic ESBP Director, you will sit within our Employee Success for Employee Success (ES4ES / HR4HR) client group, partnering directly with senior HR and People leaders who shape the future of Salesforce’s workforce.

This is not a traditional business partner role. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior executives (VP+ level leaders) across the Employee Success organization, including leaders in ESBP, Workforce Transformation, Agentic Talent Experience, and HR COEs. Your clients are the very teams designing Salesforce’s people strategy, which means your work has enterprise-wide ripple effects.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic HR-for-HR Partnership: Serve as a proactive consultant to senior leaders to shape organizational strategy, business transformation, and AI/Agent integration. You will align talent initiatives with fiscal year goals and lead executive-level hiring strategies.
  • Leadership Advisory & Coaching: Serve as a high-impact trusted advisor to the ES leadership team, utilizing advanced consultative skills to navigate a complex organizational ecosystem. You will provide values-aligned coaching—anchored in Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Equality—to empower leaders as they navigate organizational change and address engagement challenges. As a resilient communicator, you will leverage professional poise to bridge differing perspectives among high-level practitioners, building the consensus necessary to improve retention and achieve strategic people outcomes.
  • Operational Excellence: Lead critical talent cycles including succession planning, merit and compensation reviews, and workforce planning. You will act as “Customer Zero,” testing and refining internal initiatives before they are scaled to the broader organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: “Form the table” by mobilizing stakeholders across Legal, Finance, and HR Centers of Excellence (COEs). You will bridge the gap between global corporate strategy and local business needs, including managing location strategy and executive spans/ratios.
  • Analytics & Impact Measurement: Use data-driven insights to monitor organizational health. You will connect engagement data (from GIS surveys) to tangible business metrics like revenue per employee and retention risk.
  • Global Policy Advocacy: Stay ahead of international digital shifts, such as the National Cloud Computing Policy (NCCP), to advise the business on data sovereignty, digital inclusivity, and regional talent development.



You're Our Person If...

  • Strategic Experience: 10+ years of experience as an HR/ES Business Partner or in a similar strategic talent advisory role, with a proven track record of supporting executive-level clients.
  • Business & Tech Acumen: A deep curiosity for how business operates. You understand growth trajectories, product lifecycles, and the impact of AI on the modern workforce.
  • Change Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading organizations through large-scale transformations, utilizing formal change management models to improve culture and effectiveness.
  • Data Literacy: Ability to analyze complex datasets and “connect the dots” between people metrics and business outcomes.
  • Relationship Building: A natural ability to build high-trust, collaborative relationships across diverse teams and formal/informal networks.
  • Education: Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the Values & Behaviors for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, etc.).



Even Better If...

  • Global Perspective: Experience navigating international data privacy and residency frameworks (e.g., sovereign cloud policies) and their impact on talent mobility.
  • Talent Development Expertise: Specialized knowledge in executive coaching, high-potential assessment tools, and building diverse leadership pipelines.
  • Innovation Mindset: Experience working in high-growth SaaS or AI-driven environments where agility and “bold invention” are required.

  • API Integration & Authentication: Develop and consume robust RESTful services. Configure and execute precise authentication workflows supporting safe data transmission, strictly adhering to OAuth variants (including Username-Password flow, Web Server flow, and JWT flow).
  • Database Management & Persistence: Design, optimize, and maintain relational or specialized database structures to provide optimal data persistence for scoping configurations and real-time computation states.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Maintenance: Commit code, manage version control histories via Git, and interact with automated Jenkins build jobs to deploy software securely across SaaS platforms like Heroku.
  • Quality Assurance & E2E Testing: Write and execute comprehensive unit, integration, and user-acceptance test profiles to maintain software stability within an accelerated, high-yield iteration cycle.

Required Experience & Skills


  • Professional Experience: Strong foundation in full-stack software development with explicit experience building and deploying multi-tier web applications from scratch.
  • Advanced Web Framework Proficiency: Exceptional capability in Advanced JavaScript / TypeScript combined with operational mastery of web environments like Node.js, React, or AngularJS.
  • AI Integration & Tooling Command: Practical experience consuming LLM APIs, prompt tracking, and integrating agentic plugins. Expert command of modern AI-augmented coding toolchains (such as Cursor or Claude Code) to accelerate feature shipping is highly valued.
  • API and Security Foundations: Firm comprehension of REST architecture, relational database indexing, and common security authorization token exchanges (OAuth, JWT).
  • DevOps and Lifecycle Discipline: Practical familiarity managing collaborative repositories using Git, navigating automated Jenkins pipelines, and hosting application artifacts on SaaS infrastructures like Heroku.

Desired Experience & Certifications

You will be a Principal Engineer (PMTS) leading the Monitoring Cloud Events team in Hyderabad, India. Our team builds systems that handle huge amounts of data for Salesforce. We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online.
  • Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work.
  • Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need.
  • Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world.

Tech Stack:

  • Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments.
  • Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing.
  • Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines.
  • Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage.
  • Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling.
  • Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets.
  • Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage.
  • Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups.
  • Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing.

You’re Our Person If…

  • You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams.
  • You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data.
  • You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines.
  • You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid.
  • You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers.
  • You are a great "service owner," meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly.

Even Better If…

  • You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs).
  • You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones.
  • You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems.

The Experience

The next Salesforce will be shaped by how well people and agents can understand one another, share context, delegate authority, recover from failure, and accomplish meaningful outcomes together. These behaviors unfold across roles, products, implementations, data, policies, channels, and time. They cannot be understood through episodic studies or a single adoption metric.

The SVP, Research + Insights will lead Research across Salesforce Experience Design and build a continuous intelligence capability spanning Customer 360, Platform, Data 360, Agentforce, Slack, and emerging surfaces. Reporting to the EVP, Chief Experience Officer, this executive will move Research further upstream into enterprise and product strategy while extending evaluation through implementation, production, and longitudinal use.

What you will lead - 4 Connected Capabilities:

  • Enterprise Experience Intelligence + Foresight. Foundational domain research, longitudinal customer programs, strategic opportunity intelligence, ecosystem and competitive synthesis, failed-adoption and win/loss evidence, foresight, and executive synthesis.
  • Portfolio Research + Insights. Deeply embedded research leadership and teams serving Salesforce's major product portfolios while operating within one enterprise agenda, talent system, evidence standard, and knowledge environment.
  • Human-Agent Research, Evaluation + Measurement. Human factors, behavioral science, trust and delegation, agent-behavior evaluation, scenario and rubric development, production-evidence interpretation, and experience-outcome measurement.
  • Research Operations + Knowledge. Participant systems, customer access, governance and ethics, methods and standards, knowledge infrastructure, evidence taxonomy, tooling, vendors, and research program operations.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Establish one enterprise Research + Insights agenda tied to Salesforce's most consequential customer, product, platform, architecture, and business decisions.
  • Build Experience Intelligence as a live, cumulative understanding of how customers, industries, organizations, roles, and work actually operate and how they change over time.
  • Ensure foundational, generative, and evaluative research shape product strategy before solution direction and roadmap commitments harden.
  • Create a continuous evaluation system spanning early concepts, working prototypes, implementations, shipped products, production behavior, and longitudinal customer outcomes.
  • Define the research and measurement models Salesforce needs for human-agent collaboration, including trust, delegation, autonomy, authority, observability, intervention, correction, escalation, learning, and recovery.
  • Integrate relevant evidence across Product Analytics, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Services, Trust, implementation, and market intelligence without duplicating those organizations or collapsing distinct evidence into one score.
  • Build a durable knowledge system that makes customer and product evidence searchable, reusable, appropriately contextualized, and available at the moment consequential decisions are made.
  • Protect the independence and integrity of customer evidence, including confidence, limitations, contradictions, and unresolved questions, even when the findings challenge a committed direction.
  • Recruit and develop an exceptional bench of research leaders, distinguished researchers, behavioral scientists, measurement experts, research technologists, knowledge architects, and Research Operations talent.



You're Our Person If...

  • A record of leading Research across a complex, multi-product enterprise, platform, or ecosystem at significant scale.
  • Evidence that research you personally led changed product strategy, architecture, investment, operating decisions, or shipped experiences, not merely stakeholder understanding.
  • Deep expertise across qualitative research, behavioral science, mixed methods, experimentation, measurement, and interpretation of product and production data.
  • Meaningful experience with AI, automation, human factors, intelligent systems, trust, or human-machine collaboration.
  • The ability to reconstruct how complex domains and people actually work across roles, systems, incentives, constraints, implementations, and time.
  • Demonstrated strength in foundational research, generative product influence, continuous evaluation, and enterprise synthesis.
  • Experience integrating qualitative, quantitative, behavioral, commercial, implementation, and service evidence without overstating certainty or confusing correlation with customer understanding.
  • Executive presence and organizational courage sufficient to challenge powerful stakeholders, protect difficult findings, and redirect consequential decisions.
  • Experience leading a centrally connected research organization with senior portfolio leaders and deeply embedded teams.
  • A record of identifying, recruiting, and developing exceptional research leaders and distinguished practitioners.



What success looks like:
Within the first year, Research should operate as an enterprise decision system: close enough to change the work and independent enough to challenge it.

  • A single enterprise research agenda is actively shaping priority product, portfolio, architecture, and business decisions.
  • Live domain and work models are in place for the highest-priority areas and are changing what teams choose to build or stop.
  • A continuous evaluation model connects prototypes, production behavior, implementation evidence, customer outcomes, and longitudinal learning.
  • Human-agent research and measurement are informing Agentforce, Slack, Experience Architecture, and selected portfolio experiences.
  • Evidence from implementation, support, service, win/loss, telemetry, and direct research is entering decisions with clear provenance and interpretation.
  • The research knowledge environment is reducing duplicated discovery and making prior evidence available without stripping it of context.
  • Salesforce has one strong Research leadership and talent system, with deep portfolio proximity and a credible distinguished-practitioner bench.
  • Unsupported directions are redirected or stopped before major investment because the evidence is timely, credible, and consequential.



Your leadership signature
You are a truth-teller with product consequence. You combine deep curiosity and methodological rigor with exceptional product judgment. You can hold contradiction, identify the non-obvious implication, and make complex evidence clear without manufacturing certainty. You are independent without becoming distant from the work, and influential without allowing stakeholder preference to rewrite what is true.

Why this role matters
The Agentic Enterprise introduces questions of trust, authority, delegation, learning, and organizational change that no existing product metric can answer alone. This role will ensure Salesforce builds from a continuously updated understanding of customers and real work, and that the company learns as its products and agents change. The right leader will make customer truth a durable source of strategic and product advantage.

title: Technical Strategist, Product Strategy & Innovation
descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Product

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce recherche un(e) Technical Product Strategist (Stratège Produit Technique) pour rejoindre son équipe Product Strategy & Innovation. C’est une opportunité unique d’évoluer à la croisée des dynamiques de marché, du positionnement produit et de l’architecture technique complexe, en contribuant à définir où Salesforce investit, comment nous positionnons notre plateforme et pourquoi.

Vous contribuerez à notre thèse technologique prospective. Plutôt que de gérer des backlogs de sprint, la priorisation de fonctionnalités ou des feuilles de route d’exécution à court terme, vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe de stratèges produit techniques pour identifier les opportunités émergentes (« white spaces »), évaluer les options « build-buy-partner » (développer, acheter ou s’associer) et traduire les grandes tendances du marché en stratégies de plateforme concrètes.

Nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) de la stratégie capable d’anticiper les tendances : une personne sachant analyser méthodiquement les lacunes du portefeuille, évaluer les options d’investissement technique et aider à concevoir les cadres stratégiques qui façonneront notre plateforme d’entreprise.

De l’analyse des trajectoires de produitisation des capacités clés (de l’infrastructure de confiance à l’automatisation des flux de travail en passant par les architectures d’IA agentique) à la recherche de thèses d’investissement dans des secteurs à forte croissance comme l’agentification de la chaîne logistique, les outils pour développeurs et les systèmes de référence natifs de l’IA (« AI-native systems of record »), vous aiderez Salesforce à miser sur les bons choix grâce à des modèles commerciaux et techniques solides.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Soutenir la stratégie produit à long terme : Mener des études de marché, des analyses d’opportunités (« whitespace ») et des évaluations concurrentielles afin de soutenir les cadres de positionnement pluriannuels sur l’ensemble du portefeuille d’IA d’entreprise et de plateforme de Salesforce.
  • Analyser les trajectoires de produitisation : Évaluer la transition stratégique des capacités techniques internes (infrastructure de confiance, automatisation des flux de travail, IA agentique et plateformes de données) vers des gammes de produits autonomes ou des offres intégrées à la plateforme.
  • Appliquer les cadres « Build-Buy-Partner » : Mener des évaluations structurelles pour les décisions de développement interne, d’acquisition ou de partenariat, en analysant les délais d’intégration à la plateforme par rapport aux stratégies de commercialisation (« go-to-market ») indépendantes.
  • Traduire les paradigmes technologiques et de marché : Suivre les mutations fondamentales (notamment le codage agentique, les architectures d’applications natives de l’IA, l’automatisation de la chaîne logistique et les écosystèmes open source) et les traduire en thèses d’investissement claires et appuyées par les données.
  • Cartographier les lacunes du portefeuille : Collaborer avec les responsables de la stratégie et de la gestion produit pour identifier les vulnérabilités du portefeuille et les opportunités de marché au-delà de l’analyse concurrentielle classique.
  • Synthétiser les signaux transversaux : Intégrer la recherche technique, les capacités d’ingénierie, la veille stratégique de marché et les tendances M&A (fusions-acquisitions) dans des perspectives stratégiques solides et étayées.
  • Évaluer la viabilité du marché : Effectuer le dimensionnement du marché, la modélisation économique et des analyses concurrentielles pour justifier l’allocation de capital et les réorientations stratégiques.
  • Soutenir les initiatives stratégiques mondiales : Travailler avec la direction régionale pour adapter les stratégies de plateforme aux marchés internationaux, en tenant compte des cadres réglementaires locaux et du paysage concurrentiel.
  • Évaluer les modèles de commercialisation (« Go-to-Market ») : Analyser les structures de monétisation (open source, intégration à la plateforme, SaaS autonome, API-first) en équilibrant le potentiel de revenus à long terme, l’adoption par les développeurs et la défendabilité.
  • Surveiller les signaux émergents : Suivre l’activité du capital-risque, les évolutions de l’écosystème de développeurs et les recherches émergentes afin d’identifier les nouveaux paradigmes technologiques avant qu’ils ne fassent consensus.
  • Formuler des recommandations pour le comité directeur : Rédiger des notes stratégiques et des présentations claires et bien structurées destinées aux directeurs de la stratégie, VP Produit et dirigeants exécutifs.



You're Our Person If...

  • 5 à 8 ans d’expérience (post-licence ou diplôme supérieur) en stratégie produit, stratégie technologique, stratégie d’entreprise, conseil en management ou gestion de produit technique au sein d’une entreprise majeure du cloud ou de logiciels d’entreprise.
  • Solide compréhension structurelle des architectures IA/ML d’entreprise, des systèmes agentiques et des schémas d’intégration de plateformes.
  • Maîtrise des systèmes de référence d’entreprise, des plateformes de données et des infrastructures SaaS, incluant la compréhension de l’impact des couches d’IA sur le modèle économique du logiciel.
  • Solides bases en conception de modèles économiques, notamment les compromis entre les modèles de commercialisation open source, propriétaires, natifs de plateforme et axés sur les API.
  • Expérience dans la participation aux évaluations « build-buy-partner », aux stratégies d’entrée sur le marché ou aux études de marché pour les fusions-acquisitions.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, avec une aptitude éprouvée à traduire des sujets techniques complexes et multivariables en récits synthétiques pour les dirigeants.
  • Forte aisance face à l’ambiguïté et solides compétences en résolution de problèmes quantitatifs et qualitatifs pour structurer des enjeux complexes et tester des hypothèses stratégiques.



Even Better If...

  • Diplôme de niveau Master (MBA, Master of Science ou équivalent) dans un domaine commercial ou technique.
  • Expérience en stratégie technique, innovation d’entreprise ou conseil en stratégie technologique.
  • Connaissance des écosystèmes de plateformes pour développeurs, du développement logiciel assisté par IA et des outils de développement modernes.
  • Expérience pratique ou connaissance approfondie dans l’automatisation de la chaîne logistique d’entreprise, l’agentification des processus ou les applications d’IA sectorielles (« vertical AI »).
  • Expérience en capital-risque (venture capital), développement d’entreprise (corporate development) ou analyse d’investissements technologiques.
  • Un esprit d’entrepreneur/constructeur (« builder ») axé sur l’évaluation de nouveaux marchés, de nouveaux modèles économiques et de paradigmes émergents plutôt que sur l’optimisation des fonctionnalités existantes.


The Experience

Salesforce is looking for a Technical Product Strategist to join its Product Strategy & Innovation team. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of market dynamics, product positioning, and complex technical architecture, helping define where Salesforce invests, how we position our platform, and why.

You will contribute to our forward-looking technology thesis. Rather than managing sprint backlogs, feature prioritization, or short-term execution roadmaps, you will work within a team of technical product strategists to identify emerging opportunities ("white spaces"), evaluate "build-buy-partner" options, and translate major market trends into concrete platform strategies.

We are looking for a strategy professional who can anticipate trends: someone who can methodically analyze portfolio gaps, evaluate technical investment options, and help design the strategic frameworks that will shape our enterprise platform.

From analyzing the productization trajectories of key capabilities (from trust infrastructure to workflow automation to agentic AI architectures) to researching investment theses in high-growth areas such as supply chain agentification, developer tools, and AI-native systems of record, you will help Salesforce make the right bets through solid commercial and technical models.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Support long-term product strategy: Conduct market studies, whitespace analyses, and competitive assessments to support multi-year positioning frameworks across Salesforce's enterprise AI and platform portfolio.
  • Analyze productization trajectories: Evaluate the strategic transition of internal technical capabilities (trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI, and data platforms) into standalone product lines or platform-integrated offerings.
  • Apply "Build-Buy-Partner" frameworks: Conduct structured assessments for internal development, acquisition, or partnership decisions, analyzing platform integration timelines against independent go-to-market strategies.
  • Translate technology and market paradigms: Track fundamental shifts (including agentic coding, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source ecosystems) and translate them into clear, data-backed investment theses.
  • Map portfolio gaps: Collaborate with strategy and product management leaders to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and market opportunities beyond traditional competitive analysis.
  • Synthesize cross-functional signals: Integrate technical research, engineering capabilities, strategic market intelligence, and M&A (mergers and acquisitions) trends into solid, well-supported strategic perspectives.
  • Assess market viability: Perform market sizing, economic modeling, and competitive analyses to justify capital allocation and strategic redirections.
  • Support global strategic initiatives: Work with regional leadership to adapt platform strategies to international markets, accounting for local regulatory frameworks and the competitive landscape.
  • Evaluate go-to-market models: Analyze monetization structures (open source, platform integration, standalone SaaS, API-first), balancing long-term revenue potential, developer adoption, and defensibility.
  • Monitor emerging signals: Track venture capital activity, developer ecosystem shifts, and emerging research to identify new technology paradigms before they become consensus.
  • Make recommendations to the leadership committee: Write clear, well-structured strategic memos and presentations for chief strategy officers, product VPs, and executive leaders.



You're Our Person If...

  • 5 to 8 years of experience (post-bachelor's or advanced degree) in product strategy, technology strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, or technical product management at a major cloud or enterprise software company.
  • Strong structural understanding of enterprise AI/ML architectures, agentic systems, and platform integration patterns.
  • Command of enterprise systems of record, data platforms, and SaaS infrastructure, including an understanding of how AI layers affect the software business model.
  • Solid foundation in business model design, including the trade-offs between open source, proprietary, platform-native, and API-led go-to-market models.
  • Experience participating in build-buy-partner assessments, go-to-market strategies, or market studies for mergers and acquisitions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, multivariable technical topics into concise narratives for executives.
  • Strong comfort with ambiguity and solid quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills to structure complex issues and test strategic hypotheses.



Even Better If...

  • Master's-level degree (MBA, Master of Science, or equivalent) in a business or technical field.
  • Experience in technical strategy, corporate innovation, or technology strategy consulting.
  • Knowledge of developer platform ecosystems, AI-assisted software development, and modern developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience or deep knowledge in enterprise supply chain automation, process agentification, or vertical AI applications.
  • Experience in venture capital, corporate development, or technology investment analysis.
  • A entrepreneurial, "builder" mindset focused on evaluating new markets, new business models, and emerging paradigms rather than optimizing existing features.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. The Migration Delivery Lead is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.
This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

What You'll Be Doing

Customer Engagement & Value Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.

  • Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.

Strategic Partnerships & Tooling

We are seeking a highly accomplished technologist to join our Forward Deployed Engineering Team as an Expert Agent Builder. This role represents the pinnacle of AI technical expertise, focusing on architecting, designing, and building the most complex and sophisticated agentic systems to solve our customers' most difficult challenges. You will be the technical conscience and thought leader, translating ambiguous customer needs into concrete, executable AI solutions.

You will drive transformative AI solutions by tackling the technical frontier of intelligent automation. You will build first of their kind best in class experiences for the world’s biggest brands - including headless agent automations, dynamic AI driven custom user interfaces, and complex multi-agent solutions.  This demands unparalleled software development mastery, deep software architecture skills, and a relentless focus on implementing engineering best practices to deliver maximum tangible value in dynamic, real-world enterprise environments. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond.

  • Define Agentic Architecture: Design, architect, and hands-on develop the most difficult and bespoke agentic AI solutions that leverage the full power of the Agentforce platform and integrate with complex enterprise systems to solve critical customer challenges.

  • Build and Deploy Agent Systems: Apply extensive hands-on experience to integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and expertly utilize agent-building and orchestration frameworks (e.g., Agentforce, LangChain, LlamaIndex) to implement and deploy complex agent-based solutions.

  • Lead Engineering Best Practices: Master our development process, culture, and code base, then define, improve, and enforce engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, and security across all deployed agentic solutions.

  • Develop Data & Integration Solutions: Design strategic data models and build efficient processing pipelines to ensure data is ready, optimized, and secure for advanced AI applications.

  • Proactively Remove Technical Blockers: Identify, analyze, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, serving as the ultimate go-to expert for advanced agent orchestration and intricate data integration issues.

  • Drive Agentforce Innovation: Become the foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, leading the development of custom intelligent agents and influencing future product enhancements based on deep field insights.

  • Undertake Continuous Learning: Maintain expertise in the latest AI advancements, both within the company and the wider industry, and proactively seek opportunities to integrate this knowledge for product and process innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions. Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.

  • Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Apex, JavaScript, Python). Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and databases.

  • Experience building applications with modern web component frameworks like React, Angular, or LWC.

  • Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including:

    • Integrating LLMs and applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).

    • Developing custom agentic frameworks and systems.

    • Deep understanding of machine learning and natural language processing.

    • Expertise in prompt engineering, advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) strategies, and defining/automating rigorous evaluation and testing frameworks for LLM outputs and agentic workflows.

  • Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).

  • Proven experience in automated testing, including unit and functional testing, and the ability to develop test strategies and design automation frameworks.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with people from various backgrounds and levels of expertise.

  • Track record of innovation and problem solving to find creative technical solutions to new and unforeseen business problems.

We are seeking an experienced Sales Sourcing Recruiter to fuel our high-growth Go-To-Market organization with top-tier talent. This is a high-volume, fast-paced environment built for someone who thrives on finding talent others can't — turning competitor maps into candidate pipelines and cold outreach into warm relationships. You will own the top-of-funnel sourcing strategy for our GTM teams, working in close partnership with our recruiting team in a split model.
 ** This is a 6 month contract role. This role requires a hybrid schedule of a minimum 3 days a week in-office.Your Impact
  • Pipeline Architecture: Build and maintain deep, proactive talent pipelines for GTM roles — mapping competitors, identifying passive candidates, and continuously refreshing pools ahead of business demand.
  • High-Velocity Sourcing: Drive high-volume sourcing efforts for fast-paced Sales and GTM hiring, delivering a consistent flow of qualified, assessed candidates to recruiting partners.
  • Direct Sourcing Excellence: Use advanced Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, and direct outreach strategies to engage passive talent — particularly from direct competitors.
  • Navigate Ambiguity: Quickly translate vague or shifting hiring needs into structured sourcing strategies, staying one step ahead in a fluid, rapidly evolving environment.
  • Sourcing Partnership: Collaborate closely with our Talent Attraction recruiting team — handing off warm, pipeline-ready candidates and proactively applying qualified talent to multiple open opportunities.
  • Market Intelligence: Serve as a talent market expert, tracking competitor hiring trends, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability to inform sourcing strategy and advise recruiting partners.

The Opportunity: The Platform Guardian

We are seeking a Salesforce Platform Expert who specializes in security implementation. You are not just a compliance officer; you are a builder. You understand the Salesforce metadata API better than anyone, you know the limits of Apex Managed Sharing, and you know exactly which "Session Settings" break the user experience if configured incorrectly.

In this role, you will be the bridge between our security requirements and the technical reality of the Salesforce platform. You will use your deep platform expertise to architect, configure, and implement the controls that keep our ecosystem secure without sacrificing performance or agility.


Role Summary

The Salesforce Platform Security Architect is responsible for the hands-on design and implementation of security controls within the Salesforce org. You will own the technical configuration of Sharing & Visibility, Shield Encryption, and Identity flows.

You will work alongside developers and admins to ensure that every Flow, Apex Class, and Integration is built securely from the ground up. You translate abstract security policies (e.g., "Least Privilege") into concrete Salesforce configurations (e.g., "Permission Set Groups" and "Field Level Security").


Key Responsibilities

Platform Security Implementation (The "Hands-On" Work)

  • Sharing Architecture: Design and implement complex sharing models. Optimize Org-Wide Defaults (OWD), Sharing Rules, Account Teams, and Territory Management to ensure strict data segregation.
  • Shield Implementation: Lead the technical deployment of Salesforce Shield. Manage Tenant Secrets, define encryption policies for standard/custom fields, and configure Field Audit Trails to meet retention policies.
  • Identity Configuration: Configure and troubleshoot SSO (SAML/OIDC), Connected Apps, and Login Flows. managing certificates and Key Management (BYOK) where applicable.

Event Monitoring & Detection

  • Real-Time Monitoring: Build Transaction Security Policies (using Apex or Low-Code) to block data exfiltration attempts in real-time.
  • Log Analysis: Configure Event Monitoring to export logs to our SIEM (Splunk/New Relic). Create dashboards to visualize login anomalies and report exports.

Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

  • Code Security: Act as the "Security Gatekeeper" for deployments. Review Apex and LWC code for common vulnerabilities (SOQL Injection, XSS, Enforcing Sharing).
  • DevOps Integration: Configure static code analysis tools (e.g., PMD, Checkmarx, Clayton) within our CI/CD pipeline (Copado/Gearset/Jenkins) to auto-reject insecure code.

Connected App & OAuth Governance (Critical Focus)

  • OAuth Flow Architecture: Select and implement the correct OAuth flows for specific use cases (e.g., JWT Bearer Flow for server-to-server integration vs. Web Server Flow for user-facing apps vs. Device Flow for IoT).
  • Scope Management: Enforce the principle of Least Privilege by meticulously defining and auditing OAuth Scopes (e.g., ensuring an integration only has api access and not full access).
  • Session Policies: Configure granular session policies per Connected App, enforcing High Assurance sessions (MFA) for sensitive apps and defining strict timeout values.
  • Client Secret Management: Manage the lifecycle of Consumer Keys and Secrets, including rotation strategies and ensuring secrets are never hardcoded in external systems.
  • IP Relaxation: configure "Enforce IP Restrictions" vs. "Relax IP Restrictions" settings on a per-app basis to balance security with accessibility.
  • Security Center & Multi-Org Governance
  • Centralized Policy Management: Implement and manage Salesforce Security Center to define and push baseline security policies (e.g., Password Policies, Session Settings, Trusted IP Ranges) from a central tenant to all child orgs.
  • Drift Detection: Configure Security Center to monitor for Configuration Drift. Create alerts that trigger immediately if a local admin in a child org attempts to weaken security settings (e.g., disabling MFA or relaxing IP restrictions).
  • Health Visibility: Maintain a single-pane-of-glass view of security health scores across the entire multi-org landscape, reporting on KPI improvements to leadership.

Technical Advisory

  • Platform Limits: Advise the business on the performance impacts of security decisions (e.g., "How will encrypting this field impact SOQL query performance?").
  • Release Readiness: Review the Salesforce Release Notes (3x/year) specifically for security updates (e.g., MFA enforcement, Browser policy changes) and proactively prepare the org.

Qualifications

  • Required Salesforce Expertise (The "Must Haves"):
  • 10+ Years of hands-on experience in the Salesforce ecosystem as a Technical Architect, Developer, or Senior Administrator.
  • Sharing & Visibility Master: You can explain "Implicit Sharing," "Group Maintenance Tables," and "Apex Managed Sharing" in your sleep.
  • Apex & Metadata Fluency: You can read Apex triggers and understand how to query the LoginHistory or SetupAuditTrail objects via SOQL.
  • Implementation Experience: Proven track record of actually turning on and configuring Platform Encryption, Event Monitoring, or multi-factor authentication in a large, complex org.
  • Security Fundamentals:
  • Understanding of basic security concepts: Least Privilege, Separation of Duties, Encryption (At Rest vs. In Transit), and CIA Triad.
  • Familiarity with common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) specifically in the context of Salesforce (e.g., "How to prevent XSS in Visualforce/LWC").

Certifications:

  • Required: Salesforce Certified System Architect (or progress towards it).
  • Required: Salesforce Certified Sharing and Visibility Architect.
  • Required: Salesforce Certified Identity and Access Management Architect.
  • Bonus: Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA).

Why This Role?

Technical Depth: You won't be writing policies in Word documents all day. You will be in the Setup menu, in the IDE, and in the metadata, building tangible security solutions.

High Impact: You will control the keys to the kingdom, securing the data of millions of customers on one of the world's largest SaaS platforms.

Above all, they are people and customer-focused, collaborative, resourceful, and committed to delivering results.


The following is a list of characteristics that make a great leader at Salesforce. We expect our next Director, Customer Success Manager to exhibit each of these characteristics:

  • Get it Done – Drives processes that scale. Challenges the organization to think with a beginner’s mind and act efficiently to achieve the desired outcome. Calm, organized, positive, and can-do attitude. Results-driven, tenacious, drive to succeed in a fast-paced environment.

Tailors message and style to the audience, uses storytelling to deliver effective presentations and messages.
  • Motivate and Champion – Invests in and tries new things in the talent and career development of our people. Holds self and team accountable to expectations.

  • Serve as Director-level escalation and pursue each critical issue as an opportunity to drive the customer relationship.

Minimum Requirements

  • Possess a minimum of 5+ years in leadership roles with direct experience in customer success and team management.
  • ​​Experience developing and applying analytics adoption frameworks and value realization methodologies, such as Tableau Blueprint
  • Experience supporting the Intelligence Community or Department of Defense, working with cleared personnel or military customers.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching data analytics, data literacy, business intelligence, and guiding use case development
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking and ability to use data and insights to identify trends and risks.
  • Entrepreneurial and "lead from the front". You’re a proven leader and motivator, with deep experience leading technical organizations. You drive results and outcomes while balancing empathy and a people-first culture.
  • You have a strong emotional intelligence for customers and deliver customer support like you expect to receive it; with excellence.
  • You know what to say and more importantly, how to say it. You have demonstrable experience building strong internal and external relations, and influence outcomes and leverage relationships.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce's product offerings, services, and the larger industry landscape
  • Deep knowledge of data and analytics market trends—including emergent technologies like agentic AI—and proven success partnering with account teams and executive customers to drive Signature product penetration in the national security space.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce, Tableau and/or a competing platform.
  • Active TS/SCI clearance with a counterintelligence (CI) polygraph, and preferably a full-scope polygraph from an appropriate agency 
  • Salesforce product certifications are a plus (Tableau Desktop Specialist, Tableau Server Administrator, AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, B2C Commerce Developer, Marketing Cloud: Administrator, Consultant, Email Specialist, Engagement Consultant).

Note: This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in office 3 days per week

title: Data 360 - Principal Forward Deployed Engineer- Italy
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You’ll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You’ll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you’re looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn’t it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.

Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

The Design Lead must always provide team leadership, build strong partnerships and foster collaboration with the customer.

  • Leverage Design-Thinking methods and participate and contribute to new methods and offerings

You bring the Data Foundation Delivery to life, including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and the ability to operate across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft). As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. Advisory & Strategy

Architecture & Delivery

  • Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
  • Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
  • Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
  • Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines



Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)

  • Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
  • Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management



AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
  • Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
  • Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
  • Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP



Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)

  • Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
  • Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
  • Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery



Governance & Enablement

  • Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
  • Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model
  • Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP (Director level)


How Success Is Measured (First 12 Months)

  • Certification Attainment: complete required certifications to be compliant and ready for customer engagements
  • Discovery-to-roadmap / Customer impact: consistently produce customer-calibrated maturity assessments and roadmaps that secure signed charters; ramp quickly to be billable on one or more engagements
  • Delivery / Architecture standard: ship working, governed capability increments each phase, with consistent, governed, dual-purpose foundations across the portfolio
  • Advisory impact / Business outcomes: measurable stakeholder alignment and adoption; clear business (not just technical) outcomes realized
  • AI-augmented delivery: apply AI tooling to reduce delivery effort while improving consistency; contribute reusable prompt/skill/agent assets to the practice, adopted team-wide at senior levels
  • Thought leadership: bring a credible agentic-SaaS-future perspective into engagements; at Director level, own a defined, published practice POV shaping customer engagements and market positioning
  • Governance / Enablement: leave every engagement with a sustainable stewardship and operating model; delivery teams ramped and productive through technical leadership

You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ years (Senior Technical Architect) / 15+ years (Director) of hands-on data experience across data & analytics consulting, engineering, architecture, MDM, integration, and governance
  • Demonstrated delivery/leadership of enterprise data platform, MDM, integration, governance, or AI-readiness programs
  • Hands-on/deep expertise with one or more of Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft
  • Strong-to-authority-level data modeling (conceptual/logical/physical) and semantic/metadata modeling
  • Working-to-strong command of data governance, quality, security, and privacy (e.g., GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA)
  • Executive-grade communication, up to proven CxO-level advisory at senior levels; ability to guide delivery teams and lead multi-workstream delivery
  • Experience integrating a vendor platform into heterogeneous/complex enterprise landscapes — balancing platform-agnostic and platform-centric approaches
  • Hands-on-to-deep fluency with AI-augmented delivery — using AI tools as a core part of the workflow and building reusable prompt/skill/agent assets
  • A forward-looking, and at senior levels recognized/published, perspective on enterprise data, AI, and the agentic future of SaaS


Even Better If...

  • Data Integration, Orchestration & Activation — API-led connectivity, CDC, real-time events, activation

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Solution Engineering Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both solution engineering and sales. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Solution Engineering careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned an experienced Solution Engineering Buddy who will provide hands-on coaching and involve you in some of their live deals. You will also be paired with experienced Sales Development Buddies during the Sales Rotation and you also get to call your first salesforce leads and find your first deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior solution engineering and sales professionals during our inspiration sessions.

Who are we looking for?


  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree)
    • For the Solution Engineering Path, we consider applicants from the following academic backgrounds:
      Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science/Data Engineering, Information Systems, or other disciplines
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English and Arabic is essential

What does our new EMEA Graduate Program look like?

Introduction Month

During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Solution Engineering, you will then join the Sales Graduate Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. The time spent mastering the fundamentals of these complementary disciplines will enable you to be more productive and impactful upon promotion.

Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment

  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

With the EMEA Graduate Program - Solution Engineering Path, you can continue to progress:

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) for Marketing Cloud Next is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

This role specializes in guiding organizations through seamless migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms—including Granicus GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement —to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. By identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, the CSM strategically aligns solutions with the customer’s top priorities, projects, and goals.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

This is an Individual Contributor position.

Your Impact
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
  • Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
  • Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
  • Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
  • Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
  • Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
  • Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing.
  • Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience.


Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

  • Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores).
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
  • Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
  • Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
  • Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

Core Technical Skills Required

  • Marketing Cloud Next — Platform Breadth: Strong functional knowledge of the full Marketing Cloud Next platform. Able to architect solutions end-to-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
  • Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to Marketing Cloud Next — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect’s technical approach.
  • Subscriber Data Model & Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
  • Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy Marketing Cloud Engagement ) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to Marketing Cloud Next equivalents.
  • Journey & Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and priortize complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Flow native design patterns.
  • Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post-migration deliverability strategy.
  • Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API-triggered sends and event-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA’s implementation approach.
  • Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.
  • Salesforce Platform Awareness: Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, Sales/Service Cloud data model, Flows and permission sets — sufficient to design end-to-end Marketing Cloud Next solutions that integrate with the broader Salesforce org.
  • Functional Design Documentation: Expertise in producing executive-quality solution blueprints, functional design documents, process maps, data mapping specifications, migration approach papers and UAT test scripts.
  • Workshop Facilitation & Client Management: Proven ability to lead large, complex discovery workshops and design sessions with senior client stakeholders — managing scope discussions, capturing requirements and building consensus on migration approach.
  • Agile Delivery: Proficiency in Agile delivery practices — user story writing, backlog management, sprint planning and sprint review facilitation — within the Migration Factory’s MDLC wave delivery model.


Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

  • AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.

  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups

In this role, you will lead our most complex and strategic Life Sciences customer engagements, overseeing multi-workstream transformations and enterprise implementations.

You will own the end-to-end program P&L, direct the Salesforce project team, lead steering committees, and manage executive customer relationships. The ideal candidate brings a deep background in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech) combined with IT or management consulting delivery experience, acting as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams. You will sit at the forefront of AI transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize operations through intelligent, autonomous agents.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Leverage AI tooling and workflow automation to optimize program delivery, reduce manual overhead, and drive efficiency for your project teams.
  • Define the program strategy, governance, and management approach, ensuring alignment with executive stakeholders on key objectives and business outcomes.
  • Serve as the primary executive-facing delivery contact, owning communications regarding performance, expectations, and issue resolution up to the CxO level.
  • Foster and elevate high-performing cross-functional Professional Services teams, contributing to methodologies that improve service delivery across strategic accounts.
  • Oversee end-to-end service delivery, maintaining accountability for program financials, including budget governance, bid-versus-delivered margins, and contract commitments.
  • Drive the adoption of AI and transformational capabilities by aligning IT strategy and processes with measurable customer outcomes.
  • Proactively anticipate, mitigate, and manage project risks, providing actionable recommendations and strategic guidance to leadership.
  • Identify new opportunities and expand business relationships in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver mutual value.



You're Our Person If...

  • 12+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for program execution, scope, financials, and risk management.
  • 5+ years of Life Sciences industry experience (e.g., pharma, biotech, medtech) with the ability to engage credibly at the executive level on commercial, regulatory, and operational priorities.
  • 5+ years of experience leading large, cross-functional delivery teams and third-party system integrators globally without positional authority.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale, complex programs ($10M+) with a track record of achieving measurable business outcomes.
  • Proven experience managing program financials at the engagement level, including forecasting, revenue control, and earned value analysis.
  • End-to-end knowledge of system development and implementation within regulated Life Sciences environments.
  • Experience utilizing AI productivity tools, automation, or intelligent workflows within a program delivery context.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex conversations regarding budget, timelines, and outcomes across technical and commercial audiences.
  • Ability to independently manage client engagements as an individual contributor.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
