Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You’ll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You’ll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you’re looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn’t it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers’ time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You’ve built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You’ve implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).
We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.


We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
  • Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
  • Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
  • Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
  • Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
  • Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
  • Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
  • Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
  • Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If:

  • You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
  • You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
  • You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
  • You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
  • You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
  • You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
  • You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
  • You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
  • An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If:

  • You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
  • Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
  • Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
  • You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Building
 

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.



You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.



Nice-to-Haves
 

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 

  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.
  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.
  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.
  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.



Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 

  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.
  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.
  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.
  • Construire et intégrer des pipelines de données sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes de données clients. Modéliser la donnée, livrer le pipeline, valider les outputs.
  • Développer et maintenir des dashboards de performance des agents et des reportings KPI clients pour suivre la santé des déploiements et les résultats business.
  • Contribuer à des preuves de concept et des MVP qui passent de l'esquisse au déployable en jours, pas en mois.
  • Co-construire aux côtés des clients et partenaires, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en les montant en compétences au fil des missions. Laisser les équipes plus capables après chaque engagement qu'avant.
  • Remonter les lacunes de la plateforme, cas limites et insights terrain aux ingénieurs seniors et à l'équipe produit. Votre expérience terrain est la boucle de feedback produit.
  • Travailler en binôme avec le Deployment Strategist de votre pod pour traduire les enjeux business clients en solutions agentiques qui livrent vraiment.



Vous êtes notre Forward Deployed Engineer si…
 

  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.
  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en delivery technique orienté client (conseil, services professionnels ou forward deployed engineering) — c'est une exigence, pas un bonus.
  • Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage parmi Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Apex — et êtes prêt à en ajouter d'autres selon les besoins.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique des LLMs et du prompt engineering. Vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un prompt a échoué et ce que vous changeriez.
  • Vous comprenez la modélisation de données, les APIs et les patterns d'intégration suffisamment en profondeur pour les concevoir, pas seulement les consommer.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans une salle avec des équipes commerciales et des architectes clients.
  • Vous livrez du code de qualité et évaluez les outputs IA avec la rigueur d'un ingénieur.
  • Vous explorez activement le paysage IA/data en évolution — en testant de nouveaux outils, en expérimentant de nouveaux modèles, et en restant sincèrement curieux de ce qui arrive.
  • Vous vous épanouissez dans le groupe de travail qui construit quelque chose, pas seulement qui en parle.
  • Vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée de voyager ~25% du temps pour travailler directement aux côtés des clients.



Atouts supplémentaires
 

  • Expérience sur la plateforme Salesforce ou certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarité avec les frameworks d'agents (LangChain, LlamaIndex) et les patterns d'orchestration
  • Expérience pratique des plateformes de données cloud (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Expérience dans des domaines IA spécialisés : data engineering, architecture plateforme ou déploiements headless

descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Development & Strategy

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience


Salesforce's Corporate Development team is responsible for M&A strategy and execution. We help shape the future of Salesforce by identifying industry trends, maintaining relationships with relevant external partners, and sourcing, negotiating, structuring, and performing strategic acquisitions to enable our executive team, product, engineering, and other leaders to drive inorganic growth and innovation.

Salesforce is one of the most active acquirers in enterprise software with 20+ closed acquisitions over the past 4 years and 100+ closed acquisitions since 2006. This opportunity provides tremendous exposure and the ability to contribute materially to Salesforce's long-term trajectory. We apply a disciplined approach to M&A, and enable our senior executives to take advantage of inorganic opportunities that help them achieve their strategic objectives. Representative acquisitions include Fin, Informatica, Slack, Tableau, MuleSoft, and Demandware.

The Senior Analyst position is a high impact role on a highly visible team. This role will support all facets of Corporate Development M&A, including competitor and industry benchmarking, target identification and evaluation, financial modeling and valuation, detailed due diligence, and deal execution. This is an excellent opportunity to join a team that is actively shaping the future of the company and the enterprise software industry more broadly.

The position will be based in San Francisco and be hybrid, reporting to the office three days a week.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Support the execution of acquisitions and strategic minority investments, including conducting market landscapes, performing financial and valuation analyses, financial modeling, and coordinating all aspects of due diligence (pre-term sheet evaluation, detailed post-term sheet due diligence, and the sign-to-close process) in partnership with senior team members, integration, and cross-functional work stream leads
  • Evaluate potential inbound M&A opportunities against existing strategic priorities, and socialize opportunities internally as appropriate
  • Collaborate with product teams to understand product gaps, conduct build/buy/partner analyses and develop strategic investment themes and business cases for M&A and minority investments
  • Assist in market, industry, and company research and analyses to influence decision-making, and identify and prioritize acquisition targets and opportunities
  • Support special projects and presentations for senior executives
  • Build trust with internal cross-functional stakeholders, and manage communication and deal updates throughout the execution process
  • Manage the M&A pipeline, present updates and deal progress to internal stakeholders, and manage Corporate Development systems and tools


You’re Our Person If...

Preferred Background

  • 1+ years experience in corporate M&A, investment banking, private equity, management consulting, or strategic finance in the technology industry
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the Values & Behaviors for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
  • Experience working on M&A transactions within the technology sector


Technical Skills / Experience

  • Advanced skills in crafting detailed, operationally focused financial models and performing valuation analyses; strong accounting skills and understanding of key operational and performance metrics
  • Strong proficiency in creating polished, executive-ready presentations that distill complex analyses into clear insights
  • Experience with multitasking various projects effectively in a fast paced, dynamic environment
  • Familiarity with the M&A deal process from sourcing through closing
  • Ability to formulate and articulate viewpoints (written and verbal) in a clear, succinct manner
  • Comfortably interacts with senior executives both within and outside Salesforce


Characteristics / Traits

  • Ability to build rapport, credibility, and trust with internal and external stakeholders at all levels
  • Shown ability to maintain conviction in high-pressure situations and to work optimally in a matrixed and constantly evolving organization

Introduction Month

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddies who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers.   • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
  • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & French is Essential

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations


  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.

    Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Sales Graduate Rotation


  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation


  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

What’s in it for you?


  • A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:


  • After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of digital transformation. You are a customer-facing technical trusted advisor who will support vital federal missions by designing, building and demonstrating how our Agentic Government Cloud solutions solve the government’s most complex challenges. You will lead technical discovery, shape and execute proof points for customer environments, guide production readiness, and establish a clear path to activation and consumption—blending executive presence with deep, full-stack technical skills across Salesforce, modern data architectures, and AI.

Role Description

The SE is focused on helping our government customers become a true Agentic Enterprise by operationalizing Data + AI + Trust. You will serve as a definitive subject matter expert for our government solutions and guide customers across the lifecycle—from technical evaluation and close through activation, adoption, and expansion.


Your Impact

  • Lead deep technical and business discovery sessions with federal stakeholders to uncover mission gaps, pain points, and legacy bottlenecks to scope agentic solution use cases, translate outcomes/ROI into an executable architecture, demonstration/proof-of-concept (POC) and activation plan
  • Build high-impact demonstrations and POCs on the platform. This includes configuring Agentforce to demonstrate how autonomous AI agents can automate federal workflows and citizen services.
  • Deliver world-class product demonstrations that tell a compelling story, showing how Salesforce solves specific agency missions needed to achieve the functional requirements of the customer.
  • Create end-to-end technical architectures and solutions that integrate Salesforce’s Agentic Enterprise Platform with the unique security and enterprise architecture needed to achieve the technical win.
  • Design and lead hands-on technical workshops and "Deep Dives" for agency IT leads and Enterprise Architects.
  • Confidently present technical solutions to GS/Executive-level leadership and political appointees, simplifying complex tech into mission outcomes.
  • Serve as the technical lead for Request for Information (RFI) and Request for Proposal (RFP) responses, ensuring technical accuracy and security compliance.
  • Drive activation by partnering with customers on agent definition, configuration, and deployment strategy to accelerate production readiness
  • Identify automation and process improvement opportunities by intaking both process and technical requirements to remove friction and accelerate activation
  • Build reusable accelerators (demo environments, components, POC assets, playbooks, best practices) and enable others to scale delivery
  • Drive Voice of the Customer into Product; inform messaging/plays with Product Marketing
  • Leverage modern 3rd-party development tools and AI-assisted coding to rapidly build and iterate on platform configurations, front-end experiences and custom components.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years customer-facing solution/technical architecture (pre-sales, consulting, implementation) with increasing scope/influence.
  • Degree in Computer Science required (B.S., Master's, or Ph.D.)
  • Proficiency of Salesforce Core (Public Sector Solutions, Sales, Service, Experience Cloud) and the Data 360/Agentforce stack.
  • Agentic + AI fluency: practical understanding of LLMs, RAG/grounding, evaluation concepts, and how agentic systems behave in production (safety, reliability, governance).
  • Experience with agentic engineering tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce Vibes, etc).
  • The ability to run technical & business discovery to define agentic solution use cases, success metrics, and a feasible execution plan.
  • Executive + technical communication: able to lead whiteboards and communicate with developers and C-suite with equal fluency, and translate architecture to outcomes/ROI.
  • Deep technical command of multi-tier architectures, including relational database design (SQL, SOQL), schema modeling, and the nuances of high-scale web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/LWC).
  • Growth mindset; willingness to continually sharpen technical/advisory skills through required enablement, labs, courses, and certifications.
  • US Citizenship Required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong Salesforce engineering depth; Apex and Lightning Web Components (or equivalent) and comfort operating across the SDLC.
  • SQL and/or Python proficiency and comfort with modern cloud data platforms/analytics tooling (Snowflake/Databricks/BigQuery; Tableau/Looker/Power BI).
  • Experience with other agent platforms (e.g., Gemini/Agentspace or similar) and broader AI automation implementations.
  • Consumption/business modeling with understanding of consumption levers and can map anticipated consumption spend from architecture/usage patterns
  • Proven experience in modern application development; specifically, a working knowledge of Java, Python, or Node.js, and an understanding of modern API patterns such as REST, GraphQL, and Pub/Sub.
  • Understanding of the Federal Civilian market, procurement lifecycle and the nuances of the public sector mission.

The Renewals Team is responsible for managing and forecasting the entire book of renewals business. They forecast and track renewals trends and highlight adoption issues for the company.

The Renewals team partners with sales, customer success manager and support to execute retention strategy. They are responsible for conducting account review, risk assessment and due diligence while developing a renewal strategy. Renewal team members take ownership and maintenance of all renewal opportunities (direct customers and indirect through resellers), forecasting, negotiation, generate upsell/cross sell opportunities, engaging internal resources and closing renewals prior to contract expiration.

As a Scale Renewals Manager you start to handle a large number of renewals. Volume of contracts managed each month tends to be around 50 ~ 100(depends on assigned territory) for Direct and Reseller’s customers in Japan, Korea and Taiwan. You own driving the renewal to completion. You partner with the account team and develop a renewals strategy for every customer. You build quotes, review contract terms, negotiate pricing, look for up-sell opportunities, and handle objections. It is also needed to plan how to improve the current operation process and manage some contractors or outsource partners who are doing renewal management for small size of contracts .

You will be measured on renewal rate, contract term length, and KSO (Key Strategic Objectives) driving specific sales goals of your renewals and ability to negotiate favorable terms.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Drive all managed renewals thoroughly in assigned territory by identify risk as early as possible as well as generating revenue growth opportunity via add-on, upsell, upgrade, price adjustment (working location is Japan Tokyo Office)

  • Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies for contract renewals that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing the customer relationship
  • Build strong working relationships across Sales and Customer Success Group Leadership

  • Answer customer questions and successfully negotiate issues related to renewal contracts
  • Attend and lead monthly regional calls to discuss renewal forecast, top renewals, at risk accounts (if required)
  • Managing some contractors or outsource partners to deal with high transaction volume customers.

  • Own, drive and manage the renewals process in collaboration with the account team
  • Work with internal resources (Competitive Intelligence, Pricing, Product Management, Customer Success, Account Executives, etc…) to develop comprehensive ‘win’ strategies for renewals
  • Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and demonstrate strong account management capabilities to drive renewal to on-time closure
  • Communicate risk clearly and take the lead in developing resolution strategies
  • Accurately maintain a rolling 180 day weekly forecast of renewals of your territory

As Salesforce adoption grows across regulated industries and the public sector in Australia, customers want more than a description of our security posture. They want a technical Salesforce security counterpart who can design, configure and show the controls that protect their data on the platform. The Manager – Office of the CISO sits within Salesforce's Global Office of the CISO function. It is the hands-on technical voice of Salesforce Security in the region. The role connects our trust posture with how customers actually implement it, turning security, privacy, resilience and compliance commitments into architectures, configurations and evidence that customer CISOs, architects, auditors and regulators can rely on.

This is a customer-facing technical role and an individual contributor position with no direct reports. The successful candidate will spend much of their time with customer security and architecture teams, both whiteboarding and inside the platform. They will design secure Salesforce architectures, configure and demonstrate security controls, and work with the Trust & Security Advisors, Solution Engineers and Technical Architects on strategic deals and implementation

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead platform security and security architecture discussions and work with enterprise architects and security engineering teams across enterprise, financial services, critical infrastructure and public-sector accounts.
  • Design and document secure reference architectures for identity, data protection, network connectivity, integration security, logging and monitoring, resilience, and AI/agent security.
  • Map customer security requirements and regulatory obligations, platform controls, configurations and shared-responsibility boundaries.
  • Find gaps between a customer's current security posture on Salesforce, and recommend a practical, prioritised roadmap to close them.
  • Configure, demonstrate and build proofs-of-concept for Salesforce security capabilities, including
  • Identity & Access: SSO (SAML, OpenID Connect), OAuths / External Client Apps, session and login policies, IP restrictions, permission set and profile design, and least-privilege models
  • Data Security: Sharing and visibility architecture, Platform Encryption (including BYOK and cache-only keys), Data Mask, Data Detect and classification.
  • Monitoring & Detection: Event Monitoring, Real-Time Detections, Security Policies, Field Audit Trail, Security Center and Health Check
  • Infrastructure & Connectivity: Hyperforce (including Private Connect, mTLS, and certificate and key management.
  • AI Security: The Einstein / Agentforce Trust Layer, agent permissions and guardrails, prompt and data-grounding controls, and audit AI interactions.

  • Act as the technical security SME on strategic opportunities, discovery sessions and technical validation alongside Solution Engineers and Account teams
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical questionnaires, tender/RFP responses and regulated-customer due diligence, especially architecture, encryption, identity, logging and integration security
  • Train Solution Engineers, Technical Architects, Professional Services on secure design patterns and platform security capabilities.
  • Consolidate customer technical requirements and feed them into security product roadmap with Product Management and Engineering.
  • Contribute to technical collateral: reference architectures, whitepapers, best-practice guides, blogs, and conference and customer-summit sessions.

You're Our Person If...

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) and 8–13 years in information, security architecture or security engineering, including significant hands-on design and implementation work in customer-facing or consulting roles
  • Hands-on security architecture. Proven experience in designing enterprise architectures across identity, data protection, network, integration and logging domains, with architecture diagrams and design documents to show for it.
  • Identity & Access Management. Deep practical knowledge of SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, MFA, federation and privileged access patterns, and how to configure them securely
  • Data protection. Hands-on experience with encryption a management (KMS/HSM, BYOK/HYOK), TLS/mTLS, PKI, data masking and data classification
  • Platform security configuration. Experience configuring SaaS or cloud platforms (Salesforce strongly preferred; ServiceNow, Microsoft 365/Entra, Workday or similar also relevant), including role and permission models, sharing and visibility, and audit logging.
  • Cloud security. Fluency in AWS, GCP and/or Azure security architectures and native controls: IAM, VPC/private connectivity, KMS, CloudTrail and equivalents.
  • Detection & response. Hands-on experience with SIEM tooling (Splunk, Google Chronicle/SecOps, Microsoft Sentinel or similar), log analysis and incident investigation.
  • Application & integration security. Solid understanding of API security, OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Top 10, secure coding practices, and how to interpret penetration test and vulnerability assess
  • Working knowledge of industry security and compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001 family, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, CSA STAR), and the ability to map technical controls to them.
  • Understanding of the Australian regulatory landscape for privacy, cyber security, operational resilience and government security, and how those requirements translate into technical controls.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence. Able to explain complex architecture to a CISO and then go deep on configuration with their engineering team, on live calls and in workshops
  • Strong team player who works well across Product, Engineering, Field, Legal, Privacy and Partners.



Even Better If...

  • Hands-on Salesforce platform experience: Org/Sandbox management, Shield (Platform Encryption, Event Monitoring, Field Audit Trail), Security Center, Hyperforce, Private Connect, and familiarity with Apex, Flows, and integration patterns.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Identity and Access Management Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect, Security & Privacy, Accredited Professional, Platform Administrator, Application/Systems Architect or a willingness to earn them after joining.
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, OSCP, AWS/GCP/Azure Security Specialty, or SANS/GIAC
  • Experience securing AI and LLM workloads: prompt injections, data leakage, agent permissions, and AI governance frameworks.

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

AI agents are changing how enterprise software is built and bought. A new generation of AI-native companies is building the agents, models and tools that businesses will run on, and to scale they need trusted customer data, enterprise distribution and governance. Salesforce is well placed to provide all three.

Our platform holds the customer data and workflows of more than 150,000 companies. With AIforce, our platform for building AI agents, and Headless 360, which gives any AI agent secure access to Salesforce data and actions, that data can power agents whether they run inside Salesforce or on another platform.

We are building the AI partner ecosystem for this next era, and we want an AI ecosystem builder to lead it outside the US.

You will be the first dedicated AI ecosystem partner development manager for our international markets, working alongside a Partner Development Manager who builds the volume side of the partner portfolio. You will find the AI-native companies that matter most to enterprise customers, recruit them as partners, and structure agreements that work for both sides, from fast onboarding to multi-year commercial deals. The partners you sign in your first year will form the foundation of the ecosystem. This is a build role: there is no existing territory, partner book or pipeline to inherit. You will create the target list, pipeline and operating rhythm from scratch, and you will do the work yourself, from cold outreach to closing deals.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build a portfolio of strategic AI partners outside the US from zero, and run every deal yourself, from cold outreach to signed agreement and live integration.
  • Own your opportunities in Salesforce and run commercial negotiations with high-value partners through to signature.
  • Build joint value propositions with partner product and executive teams, including how their product works alongside Salesforce's own AI products.
  • Assess each partner's strategic position and shape the deal to match.
  • Work with the Partner Solutions team to close them.
  • After signing, run each strategic partnership: joint plans, customer adoption and quarterly business reviews.
  • Prospect yourself every week through cold calls, cold emails and LinkedIn outreach, as well as through venture capital firms, accelerators and founder communities.
  • Recruit partners onto AIforce and AgentExchange (our marketplace for AI agents and agent actions), and onboard them through our partner programme.
  • Find companies already integrating with Salesforce, including through Headless 360 and our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and convert those relationships into governed commercial partnerships.
  • Help design new commercial models as the platform evolves
  • Build co-sell motions with Salesforce's regional sales teams so partner solutions appear in customer deals, and track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
  • Bring partners to market: joint customer stories, AgentExchange listings and events such as Dreamforce and World Tours.
  • Bring partner and customer feedback to Salesforce product teams to shape the AIforce and Headless 360 roadmap.
  • Work alongside the Partner Development Manager, AI Ecosystem, and help set the recruitment approach and onboarding playbook for the wider partner portfolio.
  • Work with Salesforce account executives, solution engineers, product, legal and alliances teams, and with US business development counterparts.
  • Keep an accurate pipeline in Salesforce and report progress, risks and market signals to leadership.



You're Our Person If...

  • ISV partnership experience: 7+ years (or equivalent experience) in partnerships or business development, recruiting software companies onto a platform or marketplace, negotiating partner agreements, and running integration, listing and co-sell programmes.
  • AI partnership expertise: at least 3 of those years leading partnerships with AI-native companies building agents, models or AI developer tools, at an AI lab, an AI-native ISV or platform, or a hyperscaler's AI partner team. You can name the ISV and AI partnerships you closed.
  • Working knowledge of how AI agents are built and connected: LLMs, agent orchestration, tool calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar integration standards. You can hold a credible technical conversation with a startup CTO.
  • Experience structuring partner economics for AI products: consumption or usage-based pricing, marketplace revenue share, or paid access to tools and APIs.
  • Experience building a partner ecosystem or programme from an early stage, not only managing established relationships.
  • An existing network in the AI startup and scale-up community outside the US, including founders, product leaders, venture capital firms and accelerators.
  • Comfortable with data: you build and maintain your own pipeline and partner performance reporting.
  • A hands-on, self-starting approach: you prospect, run and close deals yourself, with little structure around you, across several countries and cultures.
  • Executive presence: you can lead a negotiation with a founder or CEO and present a business case to senior Salesforce leaders.
  • Clear written communication, including deal memos and business cases for senior leaders.



Even Better If...

  • Experience with the Salesforce ecosystem: AppExchange, ISV partner programmes or AIforce.
  • Background at a hyperscaler, AI platform company or AI-native startup.
  • Technical background (engineering, product management or solutions engineering) or hands-on experience building with AI agents, MCP servers or developer tools.

The Experience

AI agents are changing how enterprise software is built and bought. A new generation of AI-native companies is building the agents, models and tools that businesses will run on, and to scale they need trusted customer data, enterprise distribution and governance. Salesforce is well placed to provide all three.

Our platform holds the customer data and workflows of more than 150,000 companies. With AIforce, our platform for building AI agents, and Headless 360, which gives any AI agent secure access to Salesforce data and actions, that data can power agents whether they run inside Salesforce or on another platform.

We are building the AI partner ecosystem for this next era outside the US.

You will be one of the first two people on the team, working alongside our Senior Partner Development Manager, AI Ecosystem. There is no existing territory or partner book: you will build your portfolio of AI partnerships from zero, finding the AI-native companies that matter most to our customers, recruiting them, getting them live on AIforce and AgentExchange (our marketplace for AI agents and agent actions), and growing each partnership once it is signed. This is a hands-on role: you will prospect, cold call, run deals and own your opportunities yourself, and build the engine behind it, from target research and recruitment events to the onboarding process that lets us bring on many partners at once. It is a role for an ambitious, technically strong AI partner manager who wants to build an AI ecosystem from the start, with a clear path to leading larger partnerships.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build a portfolio of AI-native partners outside the US from zero, and run each deal yourself, from cold outreach to signed agreement, live integration and ongoing growth.
  • Build joint value propositions with partner product teams, including how their product works with AIforce, Headless 360 and MCP.
  • Run your own deals: lead recruitment conversations with founders and partnership leaders, own each opportunity in Salesforce, agree the partnership and close the agreement.
  • After signing, run each partnership: joint plans, adoption by Salesforce customers, co-marketing, customer stories and regular business reviews.
  • Spot partners with the potential for larger commercial deals and work with the Senior Partner Development Manager and the Partner Solutions team to close them.
  • Map and research AI-native companies by market and category, and keep a prioritised target list based on customer demand and fit.
  • Prospect every week through cold calls, cold emails and LinkedIn outreach, as well as warm introductions, venture capital firms, accelerators and founder communities.
  • Work with Salesforce account executives, solution engineers and regional sales teams to find partners their customers are asking for.
  • Identify companies already integrating with Salesforce, including through Headless 360 or our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and bring them into the programme.
  • Plan and run partner recruitment events, such as founder meetups, AI builder sessions, hackathons and roundtables, often co-hosted with VCs, accelerators or Salesforce teams, and represent the programme at World Tours and Dreamforce.
  • Create the recruitment toolkit: pitch materials, one-pagers, programme FAQs, partner case studies and demo content, tailored by market and category.
  • Run onboarding for many partners at the same time through a repeatable playbook, from partner agreement to technical enablement, security review and AgentExchange listing.
  • Track every partner's progress in Salesforce, find where partners stall and improve the process, using templates, automation and AI tools to keep volume high and quality consistent.
  • Report on pipeline, partners live and partner performance, and bring partner feedback to Salesforce product teams.



You're Our Person If...

  • 3 to 5 years (or equivalent experience) in partner management, partnerships, alliances or business development at a software, cloud or AI company, including recruiting and managing technology or ISV partners.
  • Experience recruiting partners and closing partner agreements, and then growing those partnerships after launch.
  • AI partnership experience: you have closed partnerships with AI-native companies building agents, models or AI developer tools, or with developer platforms, data or API-first companies, and can name the partnerships you closed.
  • A technical background, ideally in AI: either experience in a technical role such as engineering, solutions engineering or technical product, or hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, AI agents or MCP servers.
  • Working knowledge of how AI agents are built and connected: LLMs, agent orchestration, tool calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar integration standards. You can hold a credible technical conversation with a startup founder or CTO.
  • Experience running many partners or accounts at once with a repeatable process, and improving that process as volume grows.
  • Comfortable with research and data: you build your own target lists, use AI tools well and keep a clean pipeline in Salesforce or another CRM.
  • Experience organising events or community programmes, and creating clear, persuasive partner materials.
  • Ambition and a hands-on approach: you are comfortable prospecting and cold calling, and you want to build something new from a blank page, move fast and take on more responsibility as the ecosystem grows.



Even Better If...

  • Experience with the Salesforce ecosystem: AppExchange, ISV partner programmes or AIforce.
  • Experience at an AI-native startup, AI lab, hyperscaler AI or startup partner team, accelerator or venture capital firm.
  • Experience building and shipping your own AI agents or integrations, including side projects.
  • Understanding of how AI products are priced and sold, such as consumption or usage-based pricing and marketplace revenue share.
  • Connections in the AI startup community outside the US.
  • Awareness of the regulation shaping enterprise AI adoption, such as GDPR and EU data residency, the EU AI Act, and requirements in regulated sectors like financial services.

title: Training Strategy Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Position Overview

As a Cloud Success Training Strategist for Commerce with cross-cloud coverage, you set the training strategy for the Commerce customer training ecosystem and for the additional product areas you are asked to support. You connect product direction, customer needs, business priorities, and training evidence to decide where and how Salesforce Training & Certification should invest, and you act as a business advisor who translates business goals into a training strategy with a defensible rationale.


You are a strategic partner to Cloud Success leadership, using data to recommend the most effective training interventions. Your mission is to bridge product innovation and customer value realization, with an emphasis on supporting product adoption and customer retention. You do this in partnership with your functional partners in Curriculum Development, Delivery, and Operations, who own the staffing and execution of the work.


Role scope: Commerce remains the primary area of ownership. Additional cross-cloud coverage is assigned based on business priorities and available capacity, with scope and commitments reviewed regularly. When new areas are introduced, existing priorities and responsibilities are reassessed to ensure a manageable portfolio. This is a defining feature of the role, not a temporary arrangement. The expectations of the role do not change with the areas you cover: the core responsibilities and the definition of success are the same for every area, and you apply them to whichever areas you are asked to support. We are looking for a senior-level strategist who is adaptable across a changing product portfolio and clear about what excellence looks like.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership & Business Alignment


  • Training Strategy & Annual Plan: Draft and own the training strategy and annual plan (our V2MOM goal-setting framework) for each area you cover, aligned to Cloud Success leaders' priorities, with shared measures co-owned with those leaders.
  • Executive Advisory: Act as a specialist partner to Cloud Success leadership, giving data-backed recommendations on training investment, modality, and timing. When a request would be better served another way, make the case with evidence. Where disagreement remains, document the evidence and trade-offs and escalate through established leadership channels.
  • Business Reviews: Act as the primary training representative in Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews, presenting training impact data, feature adoption trends, and roadmap alignment.
  • Shared Commitments: Establish mutual commitments with Cloud Success leaders and escalate unmet dependencies.
  • Product & Success Integration: Partner with Product, Success, and customer-facing teams to translate product direction, customer feedback, and learning barriers into training strategies that support adoption and customer success. For Commerce, this includes the B2C and B2B Commerce product lines and Agentforce-enabled Commerce capabilities.

Emerging Product Coverage

  • Emerging Product Areas: Set training strategy for emerging or fast-moving product areas beyond Commerce, as assigned by leadership based on current business priorities, using the same standards you apply to your primary domain. Ramp quickly as coverage areas change.
  • Cross-Cloud Themes: Partner with other strategists on themes that span clouds (for example Agentforce and shared platform capabilities) so customers see a coherent training path.
  • Adaptive Prioritization: Work with leadership to revisit what you cover periodically, making the trade-offs between Commerce commitments and emerging needs visible.

Portfolio Strategy & Planning

  • Demand & Capacity Signal: Forecast demand, recommend portfolio priorities and trade-offs, and communicate capacity needs to functional partners. Raise gaps and risks early so leadership can make an informed decision.
  • Cadence & Modality: Recommend frequency, cadence, time-zone coverage, and modality mix, from high-touch instructor-led sessions to scalable digital formats, to get the highest return on training resources.
  • Awareness & Reach: Proactively partner with Cloud Success and Marketing to drive training awareness and reach.
  • Performance Diagnosis: When audience reach, engagement, or class fill rates (seats filled versus capacity) fall short, lead the cross-functional synthesis of evidence (relevance of the training, delivery timing, awareness) and recommend a strategic response with the functional partners that own execution.
  • Risk Visibility: Make dependencies, risks, and unmet commitments visible, and escalate unresolved decisions on time.

Training Lifecycle & Data-Driven Decisioning

  • Strategic Blueprint: Define the strategic need and direction for training initiatives in a Strategic Blueprint: the business justification, target audience, desired outcomes, and strategic acceptance criteria. Curriculum Development owns instructional design, outlines, and production, while the strategist stays engaged as priorities and customer needs evolve, consulting at defined gates.
  • Portfolio Evaluation: Lead recurring evaluation of the training catalog using a structured framework that weighs business impact, audience reach, and operational efficiency. Recommend whether to maintain, transform, retire, or invest in assets, using evidence from functional partners. Leadership approves major strategic or capacity implications.
  • Continuous Innovation: Design experiments to test new formats, durations, and engagement tactics, using data to establish what works before it scales.

How Success Is Defined

Success is measured by the quality and impact of the training strategy, with accountability focused on outcomes the strategist can control or influence. The expectations are the same for every area covered.


  • Strategic Alignment: Develop clear, defensible training strategies aligned with business priorities and customer needs, translated into strategic blueprints that Curriculum Development can execute against.
  • Business Partnership: Provide data-driven recommendations that influence training investments and priorities, with trade-offs documented when recommendations are not adopted.
  • Risk Visibility: Surface dependencies, capacity gaps, and unmet commitments early, and escalate them on time.
  • Portfolio Performance: Use performance insights to guide improvements in audience reach, engagement, and effectiveness, in partnership with the teams that own delivery and data.
  • Business Impact: Demonstrate training's contribution to product adoption and customer success through shared measures.

Qualifications

  • Strategic Leadership: 10+ years in Customer Education, Strategic Consulting, or Program Management, with experience architecting large-scale learning programs for complex technical products. Experience with commerce, e-commerce, or retail technology (B2C and/or B2B) highly preferred. 
  • Business Acumen: Proven ability to align departmental strategies with executive-level goals and broad business objectives.
  • Influential Advisory: Ability to build trusted relationships, influence senior stakeholders, and drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Data Literacy: Proficiency in using product usage data and engagement data to drive a roadmap, identify business risks, and demonstrate impact.
  • Operational Planning: Experience forecasting demand and communicating capacity needs across multi-modal delivery strategies in global markets.
  • Cross-Domain Breadth: Ability to ramp quickly on, and balance priorities across, more than one product domain.

About the role

Our Financial Services Industry Architecture team works on Salesforce’s largest and most complex banking, insurance, and wealth management customers. We don’t stop at showing customers what’s possible; we prove it by building it with them. Success here is a working prototype or a deployed asset, not a great deck.

As a Principal AI & Integrated Solutions Architect, you will be the trusted technical lead for a set of strategic FS accounts. You’ll help design agentic AI architectures that hold up under real scrutiny: governed multi-agent systems, headless and API-first experiences, and unified data and integration patterns that span Agentforce, Data 360, MuleSoft, and the customer’s existing systems. You’ll work across the full engagement. That means framing the problem with C-level and Chief Architect stakeholders, building the prototype that proves the value, and handing it off cleanly to partners and delivery teams so it scales into production and becomes a reusable play for the whole organization.

You’ll sit within an FS segment team and belong to the broader Regulated Industries architecture community. That gives you exposure to patterns and peers across financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and the public sector.

What you’ll do

Lead agentic AI architecture on strategic accounts (≈30%). Serve as the aligned architect for your accounts. Run discovery and org assessments, set the current- and future-state architecture, and own architectural direction from first conversation through production handoff. Shape decisions on agent orchestration, MCP and agent-to-agent interoperability, headless and composable design, data foundations, and the trust and governance layer.

Build to prove value (≈25%). Co-build working prototypes and proof-of-value assets on customers’ own data and objects, using modern AI-assisted development tools. Turn a hypothesis into something a business sponsor can see and use within weeks, not quarters.

Run and extend our engagement plays (≈15%). Deliver our defined engagement models. These cover the economics of an agentic operating model, headless experiences that keep governance intact, governed multi-agent systems at enterprise scale, and executive North Star architecture. Add new content and reusable components back to the shared library, so each engagement leaves the next one further ahead.

Own the handoff and the path to scale (≈10%). Package architecture, data dictionaries, process maps, and agent metadata so that partners, SIs, and delivery teams can take the work to production without losing the design intent. Hold clear entry and exit gates so delivery stays planned and predictable.

Advise executives on FS outcomes (≈10%). Translate architecture into business value for CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and line-of-business leaders. Fit designs to FS regulatory, data residency, model risk, and operating-model constraints. Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, architecture review boards, and industry events.

Elevate the team and the field (≈10%). Mentor architects and account teams. Contribute points of view, reference architectures, and reusable assets. Work closely with AEs, SEs, Professional Services, forward-deployed engineers, partners, and product teams, with each role doing its own job well.

  • Architecture-sourced pipeline and measurable progression on priority opportunities in your accounts.
  • Agentforce and Data 360 consumption milestones reached and tied to customer outcomes.
  • Prototypes that convert into production commitments and reusable plays adopted by other architects.
  • Customers who treat you as their go-to architecture advisor, shown by repeat engagement and sponsorship from executive and Chief Architect stakeholders.
  • Disciplined engagement records, so your impact is visible and credited.

  • Deep hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform (Financial Services Cloud, Service/Sales Cloud, Data 360) and enterprise integration, ideally MuleSoft and API-led design.
  • Practical, current experience designing and building AI solutions. This includes LLM-based agents, retrieval and grounding, agent orchestration, and emerging interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.
  • Builder credibility. You personally prototype using code (Apex, JavaScript/Node, Python, or similar) and AI-assisted development tools, and you’re comfortable working in Git-based workflows.
  • Working knowledge of FS regulatory and risk requirements: privacy, data residency, model risk management, auditability, and AI governance. You also know how these requirements shape architecture decisions.
  • Executive presence. You can hold a contested architecture debate with a Chief Architect and move it to a decision.
  • A team-first operating style. You’re comfortable working within aligned coverage, sharing assets, and making others better.
Nice to have
  • Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Application/System Architect, or progress toward CTA.
  • Experience on the customer or SI side of large FS transformations.
  • Exposure to process intelligence or agentic operations tooling.
  • Published points of view, conference talks, or open reusable assets.

  • Knowledge of related applications, relational databases, and ERP technologies
