Slack is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Desktop team within the Architecture & Systems organization. While most frontend roles focus on building user-facing features, this role is dedicated to building the Desktop Framework — the architectural foundation that underpins the Slack desktop client across all platforms. The team is heavily involved within the Electron open source project, ensuring the continued success and sustainability of the Electron ecosystem on behalf of Slack.

We are looking for an engineer who has deep expertise within Google's Chromium project, who is eager to lead cross functional efforts to uphold Slack security, performance, and stability within the web and desktop client. This engineer should love to keep up to date with the evolving capabilities of browser and desktop based development, be excited about the opportunity to increase developer efficiency and iterate on desktop security and development best practices alongside the rest of the Desktop and Frontend teams, and look forward to opportunities to collaborate across companies to align interests on a unified Electron vision.

Our success depends on working closely with other teams at Slack and at other companies, so communication and collaboration skills are a must. This is an opportunity to work on a team of skilled and impactful engineers that directly affects how Slack's desktop client is built.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Strategic Leadership: You will lead cross functional initiatives across Electron and at Slack associated with increasing developer productivity, OS level stability, performance, or security alongside desktop and frontend stakeholders.
  • Technical Standards: You will be contributing to key architectural decisions to adapt our existing frontend and desktop infrastructure to support new product features.
  • Navigating Ambiguity: You will thrive in ambiguity, often identifying and offering solutions to problems, like framework migrations or rendering bottlenecks, that are not yet evident to the leaders who presented them.
  • System Health: You will maintain and improve the core systems that power the Slack desktop client and Electron framework, including Slack and Electron-based infrastructure and tooling
  • Mentorship & Culture: You will build a safe space for learning and serve as a skilled and trusted mentor to engineers across the organization, developing the ability to coach new leaders rather than just individual contributors.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: You will collaborate with teammates across engineering to identify, define, and solve strategically important initiatives, acting as a leader in communication to de-escalate conflicts and drive consensus.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Team

The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce's own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.

  • Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.
  • Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings.
  • Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent.
  • Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
  • Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.

What it's like to join at this level: You'll be a trusted operator on a team that is rebuilding how it works. You already know how to run production; here you'll take the hardest recurring problems, own them to root cause, and turn what you learn into runbooks, monitors, and automation the whole team uses. You'll manage escalations and support processes with guidance from senior leads, and you'll help the analysts around you get better.
Who thrives here: You're curious, you want to know why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You can explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people, and you leave every system a little better documented and a little more automated than you found it.

What Are We Looking For?

As a Senior Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you'll independently own production support and administration for Salesforce's enterprise data and analytics platforms, with a strong grasp of native platform functionality and best practices. You'll help the team respond faster and resolve issues sooner, and you'll keep an eye on how satisfied our customers and partners are. You'll manage escalations across teams and time zones, act as a frontline responder who swarms incidents and knows when to pull in reliability engineers, own root-cause analysis through to resolution, and design monitoring that gives early warning. You'll shape lightweight support processes and reference material, and mentor analysts. You are an individual contributor and a go-to expert for your platform area.

Responsibilities

Escalation Management & Incident Response

  • Own escalations on cases, intake, and investigations across teams and time zones: set priority, route to the right engineering, SRE, or vendor owner, drive them to closure, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Run follow-the-sun handoffs so escalations keep moving between Mexico City, Dublin, and Hyderabad without losing context.
  • Track escalation trends (volume, repeat causes, time to engage, time to resolve), and bring them to leads and platform engineering to drive fixes.
  • Be the escalation point for Tier-2 analysts on complex cases and investigations.
  • Be a frontline responder in incidents: connect first, assess impact, and use judgment on when to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs). Manage the case, intake, and stakeholder communication workstream alongside Incident Command. SREs own incident resolution.
  • Meet individual and team lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART), and case satisfaction (CSAT) targets while keeping backlog health. You are measured against the same targets as the team.
  • Help L7 refine the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: mentor Systems Analysts on hitting them, and raise challenges where targets, routing, or processes make them hard to meet.
  • Spot patterns in SLA misses and satisfaction feedback, and bring recommended fixes to the L7 and the team.

Problem Management & RCA Ownership

  • Own root-cause analysis and resolution for application bugs and recurring failures, and close RCAs with verified fixes.
  • Troubleshoot complex declarative and low-code issues, and recommend code-level fixes to engineering partners.
  • Prioritize technical debt against the backlog to improve stability, and recommend fixes.

Reliability & Observability

  • Design and implement proactive monitors, alerts, and automations for platform health.
  • Contribute to design reviews and operating-model improvements (for example Operational Readiness practices).
  • Use automation and AI to reduce manual work and move the team toward self-healing operations.

Platform Administration & Enhancement

  • Deliver complex declarative solutions (Flows, validation rules, permission models) and manage enhancement projects from inception through support transition.
  • Own complex access and role-hierarchy design, bulk data loads and migrations, and sandbox management.
  • Reliably handle standard administration so the team can focus on higher-value work.

Process Engineering, SOPs & Support Reference Manuals

  • Own process engineering for your platform area: templates, process design, capture, and lifecycle (create, review, update, retire) of lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs). This is process design, not technical writing.
  • Request SRM inputs from Platform Engineering and create or manage them as needed, so support teams have the reference material they need before launch.
  • Keep SOPs and SRMs current and findable, and use them to reduce repeat escalations.
  • Write knowledge articles and business process maps that let Tier-1/Tier-2 teams resolve issues without escalation.
  • Act as SME and point of contact for development and product partners.

Security, SOX & Compliance

  • Maintain compliance with security policies and change controls.
  • Support technology compliance activities, audit reporting, and SOX controls, and help close findings.
  • Follow the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Partner effectively with vendors, engineers, and business teams across time zones.
  • Mentor Systems Analysts and new joiners, and share knowledge through documentation and team forums.
  • Try new tools and practices, and bring ideas that improve how the team works.

Flexibility

  • On-call and travel as required, subject to local regulations. Other related duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or equivalent experience.
  • 0-3 years of hands-on platform or systems support, administration, or implementation experience in an enterprise IT environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce native functionality and best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage escalations across teams and time zones, respond as a frontline responder in incidents (including knowing when to pull in reliability engineers), and own RCAs through resolution.
  • Experience with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules), data loading, and troubleshooting complex data and configuration issues.
  • Working knowledge of Service Management practices (incident, problem, change) and the SDLC.
  • Ability to design lightweight processes, SOPs, and reference manuals that others can run.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed, global team.
  • Certifications (achieved): Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201), Advanced Administrator (ADM-211), and Platform App Builder. Platform Developer I achieved or actively pursuing.

Preferred

  • Certifications: Data 360, Tableau, or other specialist or consultant certifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Data 360, Agentforce, CRM Analytics, or Tableau.
  • Experience building monitors, alerts, or automation (observability tooling, Flow, scripting).
  • Intermediate coding (Apex, Python, SQL).
  • Experience in SOX-controlled environments.
  • Experience mentoring or informally leading peers.

  • Solid track record of executive design leadership UX experience, managing and building teams across global, matrixed organizations while delivering enterprise products and solutions.
  • Experience making key contributions to innovative, successful products with a strong understanding of AI technologies and agentic systems.
  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in HCI, Industrial/Visual Design, Behavioral Science, or related discipline.
  • Experience with user-centered design principles, UX design best practices, trends, and emerging technologies.

  • Hands-on AI-native builder behaviors — personal experimentation with AI tools, prototyping, and design at the agentic layer, not just organizational direction — and insatiable curiosity to experiment, iterate, and scale with cutting-edge technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to operate across multi-stakeholder, multi-GM environments and land shared platform investments against competing organizational incentives; makes hard decisions and is accountable for them, even when the outcome is negative
  • Very strong presentation, storytelling, and cross-functional communication skills; expertise refining the end-to-end customer journey; understanding of key business metrics and data and how they connect to design


What Does Success Look Like?

  • Defining and shipping the design language for enterprise agentic experiences — including how humans supervise, audit, and collaborate with AI agents at production scale

The Slack Demo Strategy team is the storytelling engine behind how Slack shows up in front of customers. We build and maintain the demo environments, tools and content that Slack’s sales and solution engineering (SE) orgs rely on to be successful. As the Demo Lead, you’ll be the connective tissue between sales and SEs, equipping both teams with the narrative and materials they need to deliver winning customer demos themselves.

You’ll turn new product capabilities into compelling stories, and you’ll be a go-to presenter internally, delivering demos and updates during enablement moments.   • Deliver demos or updates during Slack enablement sessions to demonstrate what good looks like as well as building awareness of demo resources & tools
  • Produce recurring enablement content such as bite-sized demo video series that lead with a strong narrative/storytelling thread tying features back to customer outcomes
  • Maintain demo documentation so both the sales and solution engineering orgs have a clear source of truth
  • Track adoption/usage metrics and report out on program health



Minimum Requirements

  • Excellent storytelling skills - able to turn a product capability into a clear, memorable, customer-centric narrative rather than a feature list
  • Confident, polished presenter - comfortable delivering demos during live enablement sessions

  • “Early Adopter” builder mindset - able to work productively with early or limited access to unreleased product updates; excited about new innovation and the first to test drive new features
  • Naturally proactive - able to diagnose, scope undefined problems, and flag needs early
  • Detail-oriented and organized - able to juggle multiple deliverables at a time and builds for scale

The Salesforce Analytics platform is a key innovation driver in the Agentic world, and is as much a philosophy as it is an amazing suite of tools, including Tableau, Tableau Next and CRM Analytics. What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters

Salesforce is seeking a high-impact Capacity Planning Director to drive multi-million dollar, strategic infrastructure decisions that directly safeguard and power our global platform health. Capacity Planners scope, analyze, and forecast the massive infrastructure demand supporting our diverse product portfolio at global scale. In this executive-facing leadership role, you will work across functions, leveraging deep technical expertise and advanced forecasting to influence and inform executive decision-making.


This leader will work closely with senior product owners, engineering leads, and technical service teams across Salesforce. You will synthesize disparate data streams to establish custom models, directly shaping multi-million dollar capital allocation and infrastructure investments. Partnering with top-level executive leadership, you will evaluate architectural frameworks, product and design roadmaps, go-to-market strategies, and user growth models to ensure long-term capacity health and operational efficiency.


In this role, you will manage both financial and availability risk across software and hardware. You will need the ability to dive deep technically with relevant engineering teams and ask probing questions. It is also critical that you can context switch and operate both at the tactical, short-term execution level and the longer term, multi-year, strategic level. Deep strategic knowledge of public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and multi-substrate architectural boundaries is essential to drive high-stakes trade-offs and portfolio-wide resource planning. 


The role requires comfort with data-driven storytelling, strategic acumen, and the ability to build trust at the highest organizational levels. As a steward of Salesforce’s long-term infrastructure investment strategy, your vision and leadership will influence critical multi-million dollar business outcomes.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Enhance a trusted capacity planning data foundation that reconciles service demand, infrastructure utilization, cloud reservations, supplier availability, and cost, with clear metric definitions, ownership, and automated quality checks.
  • Lead the development and validation of demand forecasts and scenario models that quantify uncertainty, capacity shortfall risk, and the cost of excess capacity. Track forecast accuracy and bias, and use actual results to improve planning assumptions.
  • Manage a team of 3-5 capacity planners who manage reservations for various subsets of service owners across multiple IaaS providers.
  • Establish a trusted capacity planning data foundation that reconciles service demand, infrastructure utilization, cloud reservations, supplier availability, and cost, with clear metric definitions, ownership, and automated quality checks.
  • Lead the development and validation of demand forecasts and scenario models that quantify uncertainty, capacity shortfall risk, and the cost of excess capacity. Track forecast accuracy and bias, and use actual results to improve planning assumptions.
  • Apply AI assistants and agent workflows to automate data investigation, variance analysis, scenario preparation, and executive reporting. Measure improvements in planning cycle time and analytical quality, with human review of consequential recommendations.
  • Develop the team’s SQL, Python, statistical modeling, and AI capabilities through coaching, reusable analytical methods, and peer review.
  • Apply AI assistants and agent workflows to automate data investigation, variance analysis, scenario preparation, and executive reporting. Measure improvements in planning cycle time and analytical quality, with human review of consequential recommendations.
  • Develop the team’s SQL, Python, statistical modeling, and AI capabilities through coaching, reusable analytical methods, and peer review.

Minimum Requirements

  • Candidate should have 7+ years of experience in operations, business intelligence, strategy, capacity planning, financial modeling, analytics or similar positions in a related field
  • Strong analytical skills with experience consolidating complex datasets across various unconnected systems and platforms to tell a clear story. 
  • Fundamental knowledge of systems infrastructure and how services interact with the underlying hardware 
  • Experience building statistical models 
  • Proven track record using data to influence, advise, and align C-suite and board-level executives at large public companies on complex, high-stakes infrastructure and financial investments
  • Experience presenting data in a consistent and repeatable manager to various stakeholders
  • Attention to detail with a focus on data quality
  • BA/BS in Statistics, Economics, Business, Operations, or Computer Science/Engineering is preferred. Equivalent degree, or experience is equally acceptable.
  • Proficiency with SQL, Python, Claude skills/MCP and prompt engineering experience
  • Experience in capacity management, planning, forecasting and scheduling is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • SQL and Python: Hands-on proficiency writing SQL with joins, aggregations, and window functions to reconcile large datasets; using Python, including pandas or equivalent libraries, to build reproducible analyses, forecasting models, and scenario simulations.
  • Forecasting and decision analysis: Experience with time-series forecasting, driver-based models, backtesting, prediction intervals, and sensitivity analysis. Ability to explain model assumptions, distinguish forecast error from changes in business demand, and translate uncertainty into capacity and investment recommendations.
  • Data quality and visualization: Experience defining consistent metrics, tracing data lineage, and implementing checks for missing, stale, or inconsistent data. Ability to build dashboards in Tableau or an equivalent platform that connect demand, utilization, commitments, cost, and availability risk.
  • Applied AI fluency: Demonstrated experience using enterprise AI assistants to develop and review SQL/Python, investigate anomalies, and automate recurring analytical workflows. Ability to design prompts, ground outputs in approved data, validate generated code and conclusions, and evaluate accuracy and business impact.

Sev1 Escalation Manager


The Escalation Manager role acts as individual contributor incident commander to manage critical customer issues by engaging the required resources in a timely manner. The manager handles the issues in a hands-on capacity by balancing authoritative and collaborative operational modes based on the situation.

The Escalation Manager  will build strong relationships with customers, Support teams across all cloud products, Engineering teams (Site Reliability, Customer-Centric Engineering, Technology Communications, and Readiness), CSIRT, Sales, Consulting, QA, Program Management, and Product Management.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of interacting with customers, working with executives, responding to issues and incidents, working hands-on with the team, and handling stress and ambiguity. 

This role brings an operational focus on prevention, including learning from cases and incidents, and partnering with other teams on initiatives that will reduce or eliminate impact to our customers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the resolution and ownership of all critical customer issues.
  • Act as the hands-on critical issue manager for all clouds and Sev1 cases, ensuring appropriate team engagement and providing direct assistance.
  • Represent Salesforce on customer bridge calls.
  • Manage incidents to achieve key business targets (CSAT, ESAT, SLAs, resolution time, and project deadlines).
  • Partner with customers to drive operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with GEO and weekend escalation managers for seamless warm handoffs.
  • Consistently drive high internal and external customer satisfaction.

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidates will bring a balance of strategic thinking and operational execution. We're looking for someone who:

  • Thrives under pressure and navigates conflict with confidence — you maintain composure in demanding, fast-paced environments, de-escalate tension with customers and stakeholders, and lead with clarity and authority even in the most high-stakes and emotionally charged situations.
  • Communicates at every level — from a frontline support engineer to a C-suite executive, you adapt your message, set clear expectations, and drive alignment.

Tableau Software, a Salesforce company, is the market leader in the BI and Data Analytics field, recognised as the number one platform for nine consecutive years in the Gartner Magic Quadrant. We have been on an incredible journey — and we are only just beginning! We are on a mission to help our customers see and understand their data, and have been helping companies across the globe to do just that.

The beauty of Tableau is that it can be used by anyone and can benefit everyone — whether that is helping organisations to improve business efficiency, identify new revenue opportunities, or drive meaningful change across their industry. We hire based on our values: trust, respect, partnership, integrity, simplicity, and delighting our customers. We are proud to be part of the Salesforce team.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for dedicated Enterprise Account Executives to join our UKI Sales team selling Tableau solutions into our larger Enterprise level accounts. These accounts are at different stages of their digital transformation journey which offers a fantastic opportunity to make an impact in this space.

Ideally, you will have extensive enterprise software sales experience, selling SAAS/software solutions across large organisations within the industry. You're used to selling into C-level customers across multiple business areas. You have an entrepreneurial spirit, are customer oriented, a progressive, and highly collaborative solution sales professional. The beauty of Tableau is we don't sell into IT – every business area can use our platform.

This role offers you the opportunity to lead your account set and drive your GTM strategy and vision. You'll be a trailblazer, enabling your customers to access and interpret their data, and will be front and centre in helping our clients to transform their businesses for the better.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Applying strong prospecting skills to develop business within new and existing accounts
  • Defining and crafting account plans to map out business opportunities and build a healthy, scalable pipeline
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to your customers, developing strong relationships across stakeholders at all levels — from key influencers through to C-suite executives
  • Leading value-driven sales conversations that clearly communicate the impact and return on investment our solutions deliver
  • Managing your sales cycle effectively for longer, more complex engagements in Enterprise
  • Partnering with a virtual internal team to build strategic plans tailored to each account, bringing in the right people at the right time
  • Collaborating with your Salesforce counterparts to identify and close joint solution sales opportunities across your portfolio



Minimum Requirements

  • Experience: A proven track record of quota-carrying sales experience, successfully selling software or SaaS solutions across organisations of varying size and complexity. Experience managing both transactional and multi-year licence agreements is desirable. An understanding of the analytics and BI industry is a plus
  • Curiosity: You are inquisitive and always looking to learn and discover what your customers need; you keep track of market trends and are committed to continuously developing your own skills
  • Stakeholder confidence: You are able to build trust with any stakeholder, from end users and department heads to C-level executives, adapting your style to suit the audience and the deal
  • Results-driven: You are consistently motivated to meet and exceed your targets, as reflected in your track record of quota attainment across both new and existing business
  • Sales excellence: You have highly developed prospecting, planning, and closing skills — whether managing a high volume of deals or a focused set of strategic accounts
  • Initiative: You take initiative and are proactive in identifying and pursuing new opportunities, bringing energy and focus to both your pipeline and your customer relationships

About the Team


The GTM Automation team builds applications and services that help customers discover, adopt, and manage Salesforce products. Customers use the GTM Automation app to access information about their Salesforce products and explore solutions that support their business needs. We're also building shared services and APIs that automate commercial workflows and connect digital customer experiences across the Salesforce platform. We own customer-facing commerce experiences where scalability, accuracy, and intuitive customer interactions directly shape customer trust and Salesforce revenue.


Role Overview


We're looking for a Software Engineer to independently drive the design and delivery of features across our customer-facing GTM applications, services, and APIs. This is a hands-on engineering role — you'll own medium-to-high complexity features end-to-end, from design through production, and act as a go-to subject matter expert for at least one of our core domains, such as commercial workflow automation, product discovery, or platform integrations. You'll partner closely with your Product Manager and Scrum Master to keep the team's plans realistic, support and coach less experienced engineers, and help raise the bar on quality across your team.


Key Responsibilities


  • Independently drive your own designs and take on features of increasing complexity across commercial workflow automation, product discovery, platform integrations, and customer-facing experiences.
  • Deliver high-quality features end-to-end as a developer, reviewer, and tester — from design through execution.
  • Solve complex implementation problems, make sound design decisions, and act as the subject matter expert for at least one of the team's domains.
  • Understand, investigate, and resolve complex production bugs; use and improve the team's tooling and instrumentation to debug issues and ship fixes.
  • Write design specs and run research spikes as needed; help assess and evaluate the feasibility of feature requests and issues.
  • Act as a key technical partner to your Product Manager, Lead Engineers, and Scrum Master — help slice stories and epics, define tasks, and surface dependencies and risks so the team's forecasts stay realistic.
  • Understand how your work fits into the bigger picture for customers, and ensure your features are properly monitored and measured so Product Management and your team understand how customers experience them in the real world.
  • Apply modern engineering best practices to your own designs; proactively seek and integrate feedback from peers and senior engineers, and give clear, constructive feedback in reviews.
  • Regularly assess code quality in your area and bring concrete improvement suggestions to planning; help ensure your team's code and designs meet quality standards.
  • Take ownership of your features in production — monitor them proactively and drive improvements to monitoring and service-ownership practices.
  • Provide technical coaching to AMTS and MTS engineers through pair programming and code reviews; help delegate work in ways that grow more junior teammates.
  • Communicate clearly with internal partners and stakeholders — document features and processes for peers and Support, partner with Technical Writers on customer-facing docs, and be comfortable presenting your team's work to your peer group or org.

Qualifications


  • A related technical degree required.
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of independently designing and delivering features in distributed systems.
  • Strong grasp of engineering fundamentals — fault tolerance, concurrency, API design, data modeling, maintainability, security, scalability, testability.
  • Hands-on experience across the full SDLC (hybrid engineering), owning features from design through production support.
  • Experience contributing to high-scale services in Salesforce Core platform and/or distributed service environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and support less experienced engineers.
  • Passion for learning and staying current with industry trends and technologies.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with e-commerce, checkout, order, quoting, payment, tax, or invoicing systems and related technologies.
  • Experience designing APIs that serve multiple consumers, including Connect APIs, with financial-grade data accuracy.
  • Familiarity with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and the Salesforce Core platform services and integrations behind them.
  • Experience participating in post-incident reviews and driving process improvements for critical systems.
  • Skill translating feature requirements into clear, actionable technical designs.

Why Join the GTM Automation Team


  • Drive innovation in go-to-market automation, helping customers discover, adopt, and get more value from Salesforce products.
  • Build systems with direct, outsized impact on customers and on Salesforce's revenue and trust.
  • Join a collaborative, inclusive team that values diversity and bold thinking.

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

We’re hiring systems and database engineers across experience levels to build Database.com and advance Hyper, Salesforce’s database engine for interactive query processing.

Hyper powers analytics in Tableau and query processing in Salesforce Data 360. With Database.com, we’re building on that foundation to give developers and AI agents direct access to a database for application data, transactions, analytics, and retrieval across cloud and local environments.

Depending on your interests and experience, you’ll contribute to areas such as:

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Query optimization, query compilation, code generation, and parallel execution.
  • Storage engines, indexing, caching, compression, and efficient I/O.
  • Transactions, concurrency control, recovery, and concurrent read/write workloads.
  • Streaming ingestion, lakehouse writes, compaction, and open formats such as Apache Iceberg and Parquet as well as internal optimized storage formats.
  • Distributed systems, federated query processing, and serverless scheduling and resource isolation.
  • Local and embedded database execution, including WebAssembly.



Minimum Requirements

  • Systems programming experience in C++, Rust, or a comparable language, and a willingness to work extensively in C++.
  • A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and concurrency.
  • Experience in one or more relevant areas: databases, compilers, operating systems, storage, distributed systems, networking, or performance engineering.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer needs into clear priorities, practical requirements, and useful capabilities.
  • An ability to turn a difficult problem into a testable hypothesis and use measurements to guide implementation.
  • Clear technical communication and care in reviewing other people’s work.
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)



Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLVM, assembly, SIMD, modern CPU architectures, asynchronous I/O, or cloud storage would be useful.
  • So would work on SQL semantics, query optimizers, transaction processing, or reproducible systems benchmarks.
  • We expect candidates to bring strengths in some of these areas and develop others on the team.



You’ll contribute throughout design, implementation, testing, performance evaluation, and production use. That includes reading unfamiliar code, investigating regressions, explaining tradeoffs, and using real workloads to decide what to improve. We care about correctness, predictable latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.

Engineers on this team are also expected to take on product responsibilities. You’ll work with users to understand their needs and identify the problems worth solving. You’ll maintain a strong overview of database and systems research, competing products, and industry developments, and use that knowledge to guide product decisions. You’ll shape requirements, set priorities, make scope and delivery tradeoffs, and use feedback and usage data to evaluate results. We expect you to relentlessly drive the product forward, turning ideas into shipped capabilities and following through until they solve the intended problem.

We expect every engineer to be an effective manager of AI agents. You’ll translate product goals into well-defined tasks, delegate substantial engineering work to agents, coordinate parallel efforts, and review and integrate their results. Managing agents is a core engineering responsibility on this team. You’ll be expected to continually improve these workflows to deliver faster and more efficiently, while owning the technical decisions and the quality of what ships.

Scope and ownership will reflect your experience. Early-career candidates can demonstrate their abilities through coursework, research, internships, open-source contributions, or substantial independent projects. For senior candidates, we look for experience delivering complex systems and guiding technical and product decisions.

We’re looking for engineers with:

Familiarity with database internals is valuable; engineers from adjacent systems fields are also welcome.

Hyper began as a database research project at the Technical University of Munich. The team continues to combine original systems work with the demands of a production database. You’ll have the opportunity to develop new techniques, examine their behavior in detail, and ship them to users.

If you enjoy understanding how a system works all the way down—and making it work better—we’d like to hear from you.

We are looking for a self-driven Product Security Lead to join our Salesforce product security advisors team. You will be the technical authority responsible for assessing and providing remediation advice for the ecosystem that powers our clouds.

As a trusted security advisor, you'll serve as the primary point of contact for our engineering partners and leadership, cultivating strong relationships and delivering critical security recommendations during the architecture review. Your contributions will directly shape and enhance the security posture of our core platforms, ensuring the resilience and integrity of Salesforce's offerings.

You'll sit at the intersection of application security and infrastructure, ensuring that every design decision follows thoughtful security principles, and reviewing implementation that delivers it and meets the highest security standards.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • SDLC & Shift-Left: Embed security controls throughout the entire SDLC for assigned product areas, ensuring scalable, repeatable secure development practices for complex cloud and data environments.
  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment: Lead deep-dive threat modeling sessions and architecture reviews for data platforms, AI/LLM integrations, and regulated public-sector deployments.
  • Code & Architecture Review: Perform manual, agentic, and automated secure code reviews across a diverse stack (e.g., Java, C, C++), specifically targeting system integrations, AI gateways, and data boundaries to identify vulnerabilities and design flaws.
  • Identity & Infrastructure Evaluation: Design and evaluate robust AuthN/AuthZ frameworks. Audit the infrastructure supporting our cloud environment, ensuring least-privilege access and resilient configurations.
  • Security Advisory: Advise engineering leadership directly on security risk. Translate complex vulnerabilities into actionable business context, including recommending a delay to General Availability (GA) when critical requirements are unmet.
  • Platform Integration & Legacy Uplift: Lead the security strategy for an accelerated 6 month product rebuild timeline to General Availability (GA). Concurrently manage the year one security milestones, remediation, and risk exposure of the standalone legacy environment until it is fully decommissioned.



Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in a Product Security, Application Security, or Security Architecture role, with a proven track record of securing enterprise-level cloud platforms.
  • Working knowledge of at least two modern programming languages (e.g., Java, C, C++) and experience reviewing complex source code as part of a security assessment.
  • Demonstrated experience across Application Security, Cloud Security, and Data Security, including how these domains interact in practice.
  • The Mindset & Communication: You think like an attacker but build like an architect. You can translate a complex vulnerability into a business risk that a stakeholder can understand.
  • Expertise in the OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, and working knowledge of modern security tools (e.g., Snyk, Semgrep, GitHub Actions, DAST, SAST).
  • AI Curiosity: You don't need to be an AI expert, but you are willing to adopt AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Gemini, etc.) to work smarter and deliver better security assessments.
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)



Preferred Qualifications

  • M&A Security Experience: Proven ability to navigate security integrations for Mergers and Acquisitions, including legacy system sunsets and rapid platform migrations.
  • Offensive Security: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert), or GWAPT (GIAC Web Application Pentester).
  • Architecture & Cloud: AWS Cloud Security Specialist or GCP cloud security expert.
  • Active participation in Bug Bounty programs (HackerOne, Bugcrowd).
  • Proficiency with pentesting frameworks is a plus.

Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

Role Description
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Salesforce Consultant with expertise in Commerce Cloud B2B and Order Management System (OMS) to provide our clients with strategic guidance, implementation, and support. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of B2B commerce and OMS processes and hands-on technical consulting experience in a major software domain, along with proficiency in both English and French languages.

Technical consultants demonstrate thought leadership in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of solutions, including enterprise integrations using middleware tools and platforms. As such, they are responsible for the analysis of options and subsequent presentations and education of the customer/partner. They will also identify and proactively handle risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through completion.

  • Design, configure, and customize Salesforce solutions to meet client needs, including but not limited to product catalog management, pricing, quoting, and order management processes.
  • Lead Salesforce implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, and deployment. Provide ongoing support and maintenance for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS) implementations, including troubleshooting issues and optimizing system performance.
  • Develop and deliver training sessions and documentation for clients to enable them to effectively utilize Salesforce solutions.
  • Stay current on Salesforce best practices and industry trends, particularly related to Commerce Cloud B2B and OMS, and proactively share knowledge with internal teams and clients.

  • Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize daily development velocity, document custom code, and maintain strict platform security standards
  • Contribute to broader goals by becoming a citizen philanthropist and giving back to our communities through volunteering activities.
